title: Slow Cooker Coconut Red Curry Chicken & Potatoes
description: Make this easy slow cooker chicken curry with tender chicken, potatoes, veggies and creamy coconut red curry sauce for a flavorful dinner.
ingredients: 1½ lbs chicken breast or boneless (skinless chicken thighs)
1 lb red baby potatoes (halved or quartered if large)
steps: Add the Potatoes- Place the red baby potatoes in the bottom of your slow cooker, spreading them into an even layer.
Add the Chicken- Place the chicken breasts or boneless, skinless chicken thighs directly on top of the potatoes.

Season the Chicken- Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken. Add the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Mix everything together until the chicken is evenly coated while keeping the potatoes at the bottom of the slow cooker.

Add the Curry Ingredients- Pour in the full-fat coconut milk, mild red curry paste, and chicken bone broth. Give everything a gentle stir until the curry paste is incorporated into the liquid. Try to keep the potatoes toward the bottom of the slow cooker.
Slow Cook- Cover and cook on: LOW: 4–6 hours or  HIGH: 3–4 hours. Cook until the chicken is fully cooked and the potatoes are fork-tender.
Add the Vegetables- About 30 minutes before serving, add the frozen stir-fry vegetables. Give everything a good stir and try to get the vegetables as submerged in the curry sauce as possible.
Finish Cooking- Cover and cook for another 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are heated through and tender.

Adjust the Flavor- Taste the curry and adjust the seasonings as desired. Add additional salt, black pepper, garlic powder, curry paste, or other seasonings to taste. For extra heat, sprinkle in some red pepper flakes or chili flakes.

Serve- Spoon the tender chicken, potatoes, vegetables, and creamy coconut red curry sauce into bowls. Serve with jasmine rice, brown rice, cauliflower rice, or naan bread and garnish with fresh cilantro if desired. Serve and Enjoy!

title: High Protein Green Chili Chicken Cornbread Meal Prep
description: This Green Chili Chicken Cornbread Meal Prep combines creamy, cheesy green chili chicken with a sweet and savory cornbread topping for a comforting meal that feels anything but boring. Made with rotisserie chicken, Greek yogurt, corn, green chilis, and a honey cornbread topping, these individual meal prep bowls are easy to make and packed with protein.
ingredients: 4 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce (can use chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, blended)
1 cup honey cornbread mix (I use Jiffy)
1/4 cup low-fat cottage cheese, blended (I use Good Culture)
steps: Preheat your oven to 375°F.
Soften the cream cheese. Grease four oven-safe meal prep containers that hold at least 26 ounces each.
Divide the softened cream cheese, Greek yogurt, green salsa, chipotle pepper sauce, taco seasoning, and lime juice between the containers. Mix until smooth and well combined.
Add the shredded chicken and corn to each container and mix until evenly coated in the creamy sauce.
In a separate bowl, combine the honey cornbread mix, green chilis, shredded cheddar cheese, egg, and blended cottage cheese. Mix until just combined.
Divide the cornbread mixture evenly between the four containers, spreading it over the chicken mixture. You should have approximately 1/3 cup of cornbread batter per container.
If desired, top each with sliced fresh jalapeños.
Place the containers on a baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 40–50 minutes, or until the cornbread topping is cooked through and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
If desired, melt the butter and mix it with the honey. Drizzle or brush a little over each serving before eating.
Let the meal prep bowls cool before covering and refrigerating.

description: Recipe courtesy of Sandra Lee (Semi-Homemade Cooking, episode: Weekend Gathering). Level: Easy.

title: Crockpot Meatball Subs
description: if you haven’t made meatball subs yet this season, this is your sign 🫵🏼
ingredients: ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese

Add 1 jar of marinara to the bottom of the crockpot
Place meatballs in a single layer if possible
Pour the second jar of sauce over the top, ensuring all meatballs are covered
Cook on high for 3–4 hours or low for 5–6 hours, stirring once or twice
Assemble subs and top with cheese of choice! I like to throw the subs in the oven on broil for a few minutes to let the cheese melt & toast the rolls!

title: 1-Pot Creamy Sausage Couscous
ingredients: 2½ cups Chicken Broth (Add more as needed)
steps: Slice your chicken sausage into ¼" pieces. In a pan on medium heat, brown the sausage on both sides. Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
Add in your onion and garlic to the same pan and cook until fragrant (1-2 minutes).
Dice your sun-dried tomatoes and add them to the same pan. Let this cook for an additional minute.
Add in the couscous and let this crisp up for another minute.

Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Once the boil starts to happen, bring the pan down to a simmer and cover until fully cooked (should take 10-15 minutes). You can add more or less broth depending on how you like your couscous.
Once this is nearly done cooking, add in the spinach, parmesan, and seasonings. Stir until fully combined and the spinach wilted down.
Once this has finished cooking, add in your greek yogurt and stir to combine again. You can add more or less depending on how creamy you'd like your dish.
Add back in the sausage, top with more parmesan, and enjoy!

title: 20 Minute Korean Gochujang Beef Bowls
description: Every bite is filled with deliciously flavored beef and just the right amount of spice, and it's easy!
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground beef (or chicken or pork)
1/4 cup pickled ginger ((or 1 tablespoon fresh grated ginger))
1/4 cup chopped green onion/ Thai basil
2 tablespoons ginger juice or rice vinegar
steps: 1. In a large skillet, combine the beef and a pinch of black pepper. Cook over medium heat, breaking up the meat as it cooks until browned, about 5 minutes. Add the butter, peppers, garlic, shallots, and ginger. Cook 2 minutes.2. Pour over the tamari, add the Gochujang, ginger juice, and 1/3 cup water. Cook until the sauce coats the beef, 2-3 minutes. Mix in the maple/honey and cook another 1-2 minutes until the beef is caramelized. Remove from the heat. Toss with sesame seeds. 3. Meanwhile, In a bowl, mix the cucumbers with 1 teaspoon salt, the chile flakes, ginger juice, and green onions. Let sit 5 minutes.4. Serve the beef and peppers over bowls of rice. title: 30 Minute Bang Bang Chicken
description: This 30-minute Bang Bang Chicken is a quick, high-protein dinner made with tender seasoned chicken thighs tossed in a creamy, spicy-sweet sriracha bang bang sauce. Served over rice with crunchy cabbage slaw and green onions, it’s an easy weeknight bowl packed with bold flavor and heat.
ingredients: Served with cauliflower rice or regular rice
steps: Cut the chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes and place them in a large bowl. Add the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Toss until the chicken is evenly coated.
Preheat a pan over medium-high heat and drizzle in a little avocado oil. Once hot, add the chicken and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and golden on the edges.

While the chicken cooks, make the bang bang sauce. In a small bowl, mix together the mayo, sriracha, Thai sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Taste and adjust by adding more chili sauce if you like extra heat or sweetness.
Once the chicken is cooked through, pour in all but a few tablespoons of the sauce and stir to coat. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken and get slightly crispy around the edges.

To assemble, start with a base of cauliflower rice or regular rice. Add a handful of cabbage slaw, then spoon the bang bang chicken on top. Drizzle with the reserved sauce and garnish with sliced green onions. Enjoy!

title: 5 Minute Dinner Prep: Salsa Verde Chicken Bake
description: 🌶️🍗🌽5 Minute Dinner Prep: Salsa Verde Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice
Salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, paprika
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a 9x13 casserole dish, add rice, chicken broth, salsa verde, black beans, and corn. Stir to combine.
Nestle chicken into the dish and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, and paprika. Top with cream cheese.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45–50 minutes. (Cook time will vary depending on your dish, rice, chicken size, and how tightly it’s covered—always check that chicken reaches 165°F.)
Remove from oven, shred chicken, and stir everything together.
Top with shredded Monterey Jack cheese and bake or broil for 5–10 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve with:

title: 5-Ingredient Triple Berry Crisp with Frozen Berries
description: Effortless and delicious 5-Ingredient Triple Berry Crisp, crafted with frozen mixed berries and a simple, wholesome crisp topping! This fruit crisp is not only simple to make, but also easy to adapt to a variety of diets, making it a perfect treat for any occasion. Serve it warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for a delicious and healthy dessert!
ingredients: 1/4 cup gluten-free all purpose flour (or regular all purpose flour)
3/4 cup gluten-free all purpose flour (or almond flour)
steps: Preheat oven to 350° Fahrenheit.
Add all berry ingredients to a 9-inch baking dish and toss together until evenly coated, then spread the berries into an even layer around the dish.
Add all crisp ingredients to a large bowl. Use a fork to mix together, until a crumbly mixture forms. Sprinkled the crisp topping evenly over the berries.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the berries are super soft, then let cool slightly before serving with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. YUM!

title: Sloppy Joe Sweet Potato Boats
description: Tender roasted sweet potatoes, homemade sloppy joe filling, and melted mozzarella come together in these Sloppy Joe Sweet Potato Boats for a comforting dinner with a balanced twist. They're an easy high-protein meal that's great for weeknight dinners, meal prep, or anyone looking for a healthier take on a nostalgic family favorite.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, (sliced lengthwise into 1-inch slices)
steps: Start by preheating your oven to 400℉.
Poke holes with a fork into both of your sweet potatoes. Place in the microwave for 2 minutes. This will make the cutting process much easier.

Once out of the microwave, slice the sweet potato into 1-inch thick slices lengthwise. I usually get about 4-5 slices of each sweet potato. Add to a baking sheet, spray with some avocado oil, and season with some salt and pepper. Place in the oven for 20-25 minutes until they can easily be pierced with a fork.
Meanwhile, prep the sloppy joe meat mixture. Preheat a large pan to medium-high heat. Add the avocado oil and then the ground beef. Cook for 7-10 minutes until fully cooked.
Once the meat has cooked, add the diced bell pepper and onion. Saute for 3-5 minutes until soft.

Next, add the ketchup, worcestershire, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, dijon mustard, and seasonings. Mix well and bring to a low simmer. Simmer for 5-10 minutes until the sweet potatoes are ready. Taste the mixture and add salt and pepper as necessary.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, place the cooked meat mixture on top of the sweet potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Put them back in the oven for about 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Broil for the last minute or so until the cheese starts to get brown.
Serve immediately with your favorite toppings! I chose some pickled red onions and pickled jalapenos. Enjoy!

title: ABC Baby Muffins (Apple, Banana and Carrot!)
description: These are deliberately very moist (and moister than regular muffins) to ensure they are easy for baby to chew and swallow, so expect that from the interior. They have three types of produce in the mix and are a yummy breakfast or snack.
ingredients: 1 cup mashed very ripe banana ((about 2-3 small bananas))
½ cup shredded apple ((about 1 small apple))
¼ cup shredded carrot ((about 1 small carrot))
¼ cup melted unsalted butter ((slightly cooled))
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degree F and grease a 24 cup mini muffin pan with nonstick spray.
Place the banana, apple, carrot, milk, butter, egg, and vanilla into a medium bowl. Stir together.
Gently, but thoroughly, stir in the flour, oats, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Divide batter among the prepared muffin pan, filling each cup to the edge. (You'll use about 2 tablespoons batter in each mini muffin cup).
Bake for 16-20 minutes or until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out cleanly. (I do 18 minutes in my oven.)
Let cool for a few minutes in the pan, then transfer to a wire rack to cool fully. Dice up to serve to a baby eating finger foods or offer one whole to a baby eating baby led weaning-style foods.

steps: In a pitcher or a clear glass bottle with a swing top, add in (with a funnel) the tequila, lime juice, apple cider, water, maple syrup and and close the lid. Shake the bottle with the lid tightly secured until all ingredients are distributed.

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Soft and chewy Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies made with ripe bananas, rich brown butter, and melty dark chocolate chips. Sweet banana flavor, buttery taste, and gooey centers make these cookies warm, cozy, and irresistible.
ingredients: ⅔ cup coconut sugar (or light brown sugar)
2 ⅔ cup gluten free flour (see note)
steps: First, brown the butter. Place the two sticks of butter in a skillet over low medium heat. Stir occasionally, until the butter has turned a golden brown color.
Remove from the heat and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the gluten free flour, baking soda, sea salt, and coconut sugar. Stir to combine.
Then, add in the brown butter, egg yolks, vanilla, and mashed banana. Stir together.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Place the bowl in your fridge for 30 to 45 minutes.
After that, preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Line a pan with parchment paper.
Use a cookie scoop to scoop out balls of dough. Leave at least 3 inches of space between each dough ball.
Bake for 12 to 13 minutes. The cookies will look very gooey still. Remove from the oven and allow these cookies to cool for 15 minutes on the pan.
Finally, carefully remove to a cooling rack. Top with flaky sea salt if desired.

title: Banana Oatmeal Muffins (SO Good!)
description: With just a handful of nutritious ingredients, you can bake up super easy Banana Oatmeal Muffins to share with the kids. For the best flavor and sweetness, use bananas with a lot of brown spots. Bonus: These store so well in the fridge for days!

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F and grease 10 cups of a standard-size muffin tin.
Place the oats into a food processor or blender. Grind for about 30 seconds or until they resemble a coarse flour.
Add the rest of the ingredients except the chocolate chips, if using.
Blend until very smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides of the blender if needed.
Divide among 10 muffin cups. You want each cup to be about 3/4 full. Top with chocolate chips if using.

Bake for 20-22 minutes or until firm to the touch and lightly golden brown around the edges. Let cool in the pan for 5-10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack (or just tilt a bit in the pan to let air flow underneath) to cool.
Serve warm, at room temperature, or chilled.

description: Now THIS is a fall drink!

1 cinnamon stick, plus more for garnish
1 pinch kosher salt Ice, as needed Thin apple slices, for garnish

2 cups powdered sugar 1/2 cup softened butter 1/2 tsp almond extract 2-3 tablespoons heavy cream or milk Pink coloring (few drops) Combine powdered sugar and butter with a hand mixer at low speed then pick up speed as it starts to form small crumbs. Keep mixing until it’s a smooth and fluffy consistency. Add in almond extract and heavy cream and mix again. Add more cream until desired texture. Lastly add a few drops of pink coloring and mix one more time. Spread frosting over the cookie cake. Top with optional sprinkles. Enjoy! 😋 Cookie cake recipe credit all things mamma Copycat crumbl pink sugar frosting recipe credit party pinching

title: Blackberry Baked Oats
description: Ain’t nooooobody got time to play Chef in the AM girlfriend!
ingredients: 20 mins...AND you meal prepped it beforehand so really it actually took
4 small (or two large) scoops vanilla protein (I love my VITA-PCOS protein)
steps: Mix-ins:
1/2 c chopped walnuts + 1 c chopped blackberries
Crisp topping:
1/4 c rolled oats + pinch cinnamon and sea salt + 1 Tbsp chopped walnuts + 1-2 Tbsp granulated sweetener (I used allulose, but coconut sugar or monk fruit work too)

Blend all ingredients (except mix-ins and crisp topping ingredients) and pour into 4 equal portions inside ramekins. Divide blackberries and walnuts aka the mix-ins equally among ramekins and stir gently.
In a small bowl, mix up the crisp topping ingredients.
Top each ramekin with a spoonful of the crisp topping, and chopped walnuts and sliced blackberries (optional) and bake 20 mins. These make great make-ahead meal prepped brekkies for eating on the go!

description: Soft blueberry cottage cheese muffins made with pancake mix. These high-protein, toddler-friendly muffins are easy to prep and perfect for quick breakfasts or snacks.
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese (can sub with Greek yogurt or thick dairy-free yogurt)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line or grease a muffin tin.
In a bowl or blender, mix the cottage cheese, eggs, pancake mix, and milk until mostly smooth. (if subbing with flour the whisk flour + baking powder + salt together first)
Then gently fold in the blueberries (or other mix-ins).

Divide batter into muffin cups (about ¾ full) and bake for 15-20 minutes, until set and lightly golden. Let cool for a few minutes before removing. Enjoy! I love smearing a little butter in the middle!

description: Boneless Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪 IMO, the best type!
ingredients: 2 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or extract
steps: In a medium bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar together with an electric mixer for 3–4 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Mix in the eggs and vanilla. Beat for another 1–2 minutes until smooth and creamy.
In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, baking soda, and baking powder. Then add in the salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients into the creamed mixture. Mix just until combined.
Fold in your chocolate chips.
Wrap your bowl and let the dough chill in the refrigerator 2-24 hrs.
Scoop and roll dough in your hands into your preferred cookie size and roll into balls. Place on prepared baking sheets, spacing about 2 inches apart.
Preheat the oven to 375F and bake for 11 minutes. Once they are done baking, remove, tap the pan on the counter and let them sit on the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
Caramelized edges and soft in the center. Exactly how a cookie should be.

title: Breakfast Enchiladas
description: Tender eggs, gooey cheese and savory sausage wrapped in a flour tortilla and smothered in enchilada sauce make this a must-try breakfast recipe.
steps: In a pan over medium to high heat add your sausage, diced onion, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes. When sausage is halfway cooked add the hash browns to the pan.
Cook the sausage until fully browned. Remove the pan from the heat and gently fold in the cottage cheese to your hash brown and sausage mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, salt, pepper, and half of the can of enchilada sauce. Set aside the remaining enchilada sauce.
Fill tortillas with the sausage mixture and a small amount of shredded cheese. Roll and place each filled tortilla seam-side down in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the enchiladas. Spoon any remaining meat mixture on top of the dish.
When ready to bake, pre-heat the oven to 350 F. Top the baking dish with any remaining enchilada sauce. Sprinkle with remaining shredded cheese and bacon bits
Place dish in the oven and allow to bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes or until the eggs are set and edges of enchiladas are golden.
Remove pan from the oven and serve enchiladas warm with toppings like sour cream, avocado and salsa. Enjoy!

title: Breakfast Pizza
description: Sheet Pan Breakfast Pizza is easy to make and freezes/reheats well making it an awesome breakfast prep!
ingredients: 2 packages of Pizza Crust + ingredients needed to make pizza crust
Gravy (3 tbsp butter, 3 tbsp flour, and 2 cups of milk)
Shredded cheddar cheese Shredded Mozzarella cheese
steps: Cook bacon in the oven at 400 degrees F on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes.
Mix pizza crust following the directions on the package. Spread the pizza crust out over a large sheet pan. Poke holes in the pizza crust and prebake following the directions on the package.
Scramble at least 4 eggs, season with salt and pepper, and set aside.

Make the gravy by melting 3 tbsp of butter in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add 3 tbsp of flour and stir together. Let flour and butter cook for one minute. Add 2 cups of milk and stir continuously until gravy reaches your desired consistency seasoning with salt and pepper. After prebaking the pizza crust, spread some of the gravy over the top. Top with shredded cheese, eggs, and chopped bacon.
Bake at 475 degrees F for about 10 minutes. Enjoy!
I always put leftovers in the freezer and reheat in the air fryer at 400 degrees for 5-7 minutes.

title: Brown Butter Brownies
description: Brown butter and sourdough discard BROWNIES.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark chocolate chunks or chips Flakey sea salt if you are feeling crazy!
steps: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease or line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper.

In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Let it cook for a few minutes until it starts to foam and turns golden brown with a nutty smell. Take it off the heat and let it cool for a couple minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the browned butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until combined.
Add the egg and mix until the texture looks smooth and glossy.
Stir in the vanilla and sourdough discard until everything is well mixed.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the cocoa powder, flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix just until combined
Fold in the chocolate chunks, if you’re using them.
Pour the batter into your prepared pan and smooth out the top.
Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until the edges are set and a toothpick inserted near the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Let cool in the pan before slicing

title: Brown Butter Cinnamon Rolls
description: These brown butter cinnamon rolls are the perfect Fall twist on one of my favorite recipes! Brown butter is used in both the dough and filling, and of course, it's all topped with a brown butter cream cheese icing. It's a drool-worthy combination that's sure to become a Fall staple!
ingredients: 2 cups butter unsalted, cold and cut into Tbsp-sized pieces (454g)
4 1/2 tsp (2 packets) instant dry yeast (14g, 1/2 oz.)
1/4 cup heavy cream - to be added later (45g)
2 tsp vanilla extract or vanilla bean paste (10g)
2 Tbsp heavy cream or milk, room temperature (30g)
steps: The first step is to brown the butter. Get a heatproof bowl out to pour the butter into once it's browned. Then place 2 cups of unsalted butter in a large, light-colored frying pan (to make it easier to see) over medium heat. Stir the butter the entire time with a rubber spatula to prevent the milk solids from burning!

Once melted, the butter will begin to foam and sizzle around the edges. Keep stirring!! The butter should turn golden brown after 5–6 minutes and be topped with a foamy layer of bubbles. Shortly after this, the foam should kind of fade away, and the milk solids at the bottom of the pan will be a perfectly toasted brown. It should have a strong, nutty aroma.

Immediately remove the pan from heat and pour the butter into a heatproof bowl to stop the cooking process. If left in the hot pan, the milk solids will burn. It can happen in a flash, trust me!! Set aside.
In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, combine 4 cups of flour, 2 packets of instant dry yeast, and 1 tsp fine salt.

In a separate bowl, combine 1 cup milk, 1/2 cup melted brown butter, and 1/2 cup granulated sugar. Heat for 30-60 seconds in the microwave and stir to combine the ingredients. The mixture should be warm but not hot to the touch (otherwise it can kill the yeast!).

Slowly pour the warm milk mixture into the flour mixture and mix on medium-low speed with a dough hook or by hand. Scrape around the edges with a rubber spatula to make sure all the flour gets incorporated.

Add 2 large eggs, one at a time. Mix on medium speed until a sticky dough ball forms. Continue to mix the dough on medium speed for a couple of minutes until the dough becomes more elastic and looks smooth.

Then mix in additional flour, 1 Tbsp at a time, on a low speed until the dough is tacky but no longer sticky (I usually add 1-2 additional Tbsp of flour). It should pull away/no longer stick to the sides of your mixing bowl once it's ready to rest. Another way to test the dough is to tap it with your finger. It should be tacky, but shouldn't stick to your finger or leave any residue on your finger.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside to let the dough rest for 10-20 minutes to allow the gluten to relax. This will make it easier to roll out.

While the dough rests, make the cinnamon roll filling. Add 3/4 cup melted brown butter, 1 1/4 cups packed brown sugar, 2 Tbsp ground cinnamon, and 1/2 tsp fine salt to a medium-sized bowl. Mix together until combined, then set aside. The mixture should have a thick, paste-like consistency. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 200°F/93°C (to help the cinnamon rolls rise), and line a metal 9x13-inch pan. If you're making these the day before, don't preheat the oven. Set aside.

Place the dough on a lightly floured surface and roll it into a large rectangle that's about 24 in x 18 in. Spread 2/3 of the filling in a thin layer across the dough with an offset spatula or butter knife.
Mix 1/4 cup of heavy cream into the remaining filling, then spread it onto the bottom of the prepared 9x13-inch pan to give the cinnamon rolls deliciously sticky bottoms.

Use a rolling pastry cutter or pizza cutter to cut 12 equal strips that are about 2" wide - this is why it's important that the dough is 24" wide! If it's shorter, you may need to cut your strips a bit narrower. Then roll each cinnamon roll up individually. Place them in the prepared 9 in x 13 in pan. You can also roll the dough into a log and cut each piece with a knife or dental floss if you prefer!

If you are making these cinnamon rolls the night before, cover the cinnamon rolls tightly with plastic wrap and place them in the fridge overnight. The following morning, take them out of the fridge and preheat the oven to 200°F/93°C. Then turn off the oven, cover the rolls with foil, and place the rolls in the oven for about 30 minutes, until they've risen.

If you make these the morning of, turn off the oven, cover the rolls with foil, and place them in the oven to rise for about 30 minutes. MAKE SURE YOU'VE TURNED THE OVEN OFF. We want a nice cozy place for the rolls to rise, but we don't want to bake them yet.

At this point, they should look puffier and have grown about twice in size. Preheat the oven to 350°F/175°C. Then bake the rolls for 24-28 minutes, or until they're just starting to brown. Rotate the pan halfway through to help them bake evenly.

While the cinnamon rolls rise and bake, make the brown butter cream cheese icing. Mix 1/4 cup softened brown butter, 1/4 cup room-temperature cream cheese, 2 tsp vanilla extract, and 1/4 tsp salt together with a spoon or electric hand mixer.
Then mix in 1 cup of powdered sugar and 2 Tbsp of heavy cream or milk at a low speed until it is smooth.

Let the cinnamon rolls cool for about 10 minutes, then spoon the icing over them and enjoy warm! Store any leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for a few hours, or in the fridge for up to 5 days.

title: Brown Butter Oreo M&M Chip Cookies (Soft, Chewy, Bakery Style)
description: These brown butter Oreo M&M chip cookies are soft, chewy, and packed with flavor. Made with browned butter, crushed Oreos, M&Ms, and chocolate chips for the ultimate cookie.
steps: Add butter to a saucepan over low to medium heat and brown, stirring constantly. Remove from heat once golden and nutty. Let cool slightly.
In a large bowl, mix brown butter with brown sugar and granulated sugar for 2 minutes.
Add egg, egg yolks, and vanilla extract and mix until combined.
Fold in flour, cornstarch (if using), baking powder, and salt until just combined.
Fold in Oreos, M&Ms, chocolate chips, and sprinkles if using.
Refrigerate dough for 30 minutes.
Scoop into 24 balls and place on a lined baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 9 to 11 minutes until edges are set and centers are soft.
Cool and enjoy.

title: Brown Sugar Maple Cookie Pie
description: Super simple...made with browned butter, brown sugar, maple, eggs, and plenty of chocolate...THE Thanksgiving pie!
ingredients: vanilla sugar or coarse sugar, for sprinkling ((optional))
1 cup light or dark brown sugar
1 - 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips or chunks
steps: 1. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven. Preheat the oven to 350° F.2. Fit the pie crust into an 8-inch pie plate. Brush the edges of the crust with beaten egg, then sprinkle with vanilla sugar (or coarse sugar). Lightly prick the bottom of the dough with a fork. Freeze 10 minutes.3. Meanwhile, add the butter to a small saucepan set over medium heat, cook until the butter begins to brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer to a heatproof bowl. Let cool.4. Whisk together the brown sugar and 2 eggs, and 1 egg yolk until well combined. Add the maple syrup and cream. Whisk in the brown butter and vanilla until smooth. Fold in the chocolate chips. Pour the mixture into the crust.5. Bake for 55-60 minutes, until the pie is puffed on top, but still wiggly in the center. The longer you bake, the more set your pie will be. Remove from the oven and let cool 20-30 minutes, then serve the pie warm, sprinkled with sea salt (if desired), and dolloped with whip cream. Or serve are room temp. Both options are great! 6. To make the whipped cream, whip the cream using an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Add the maple syrup and vanilla. Whip until combined and fluffy.

title: Brown Sugar Pumpkin Spice Latte
description: If you add… 🎃☕️🤎
ingredients: A pinch of flaky sea salt
A drizzle of vanilla bean paste
steps: Shake until light and foamy
Ice
A dash of pumpkin spice
Oat milk
Top with your shaken espresso
…you get the yummiest Brown Sugar Pumpkin Spice Latte you can make at home. 🎃🤎
Sweet brown sugar, real pumpkin, vanilla, and warm pumpkin spice come together for the perfect cozy fall coffee.

title: Brownie Pie
description: Rich, fudgy, and totally decadent. This Brownie Pie layers chewy cookie dough with intense dark chocolate brownie. It’s a thick, gooey treat with a buttery finish and plenty of chocolate chips. Simple ingredients, amazing taste!
ingredients: ½ cup dark chocolate chips (to mix in)
steps: First, preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Spray a pie plate with nonstick spray.
Make the cookie dough. In a large mixing bowl, add cold butter and coconut sugar. Mix on high until no clumps of butter remain, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Then, add in egg and vanilla. Stir to combine.
Add in flour, baking soda and sea salt. Stir to combine.
Fold in chocolate chips. Press this mixture into the oiled pie plate. It should be no thicker than ½ inch.
Then, make the brownie batter.
Add melted butter and 1 cup dark chocolate chips to a bowl. Stir until creamy and fully melted. If needed, microwave for 10 to 15 seconds. Set aside.
In a mixing bowl, add eggs and sugar. Whisk vigorously for 2 to 3 minutes, until light and frothy.
Add the melted chocolate mixture to the mixing bowl. Stir to combine.
Then, add in dark cocoa powder, vanilla, flour and espresso powder. Stir to combine.
Fold in extra chocolate chips if desired.
Pour batter into the pie plate on top of the cookie dough. Smooth out into one even layer.
Bake for 36 to 40 minutes, or until the edges are set and the middle is no longer jiggly.
Finally, remove from the oven. Cool for at least 4 hours before slicing and serving.

title: Brownie Trifle
description: Brownie Trifle 1 pkg.
ingredients: 2 (3 ½ oz) white chocolate or vanilla instant pudding
1 container cool whip Toffee bits Prepare/bake brownies according to directions.
Dissolve coffee granules with warm water and add milk. In separate bowl, whisk pudding mix with milk mixture until it begins to thicken.
steps: Fold in cool whip.
Cut brownies into 1 inch cubes.
Layer
⅓ of brownie bits into bowl.
Top with ⅓ pudding mixture, pressing lightly.
Top with ⅓ toffee bits
Repeat layers 2 more times.

title: Buffalo Chicken Meatballs
description: Fall-inspired meal prep that tastes good reheated (part 3) because buffalo chicken screams fall 🍁✨🍗
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko or Italian bread crumbs
for topping: green onions, more buffalo sauce, ranch or blue cheese
Veggie of choice (I used steamed broccoli, but Brussels sprouts would be good too!)
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, combine chicken, bread crumbs, egg, celery, carrot, garlic, onion, ranch seasoning, 3 tbsp buffalo sauce, salt + pepper & mix until well combined. Roll into balls and place on a greased sheet pan. Bake for 25 minutes or until the meatballs look golden brown & slightly crispy.

While meatballs are baking, prepare rice & veggies. Remove meatballs from oven when they’re done and mix with remaining 1/3c of buffalo sauce. Add rice, veggies, and meatballs to meal prep containers and top with green onions & ranch/blue cheese!

title: Buffalo Chicken Wrap
description: Buffalo Chicken Wrap with Easy Ranch Slaw 👌🏼 Ingredients: 6-7 Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, diced 1 tsp EACH Salt, Pepper & Garlic Powder 1/2 C Buffalo Sauce 1/2 C Greek Yogurt 1/2 Lemon, juiced 1/2 Packet Dry Ranch Mix 1/2 tsp Fresh Dill (optional) Shredded Cheddar Cheese Large Tortillas
ingredients: 1 tsp EACH Salt, Pepper & Garlic Powder
1/2 tsp Fresh Dill (optional) Shredded Cheddar Cheese Large Tortillas
steps: Prepare your slaw by whisking together Greek yogurt, lemon juice, dill and ranch seasoning.
Mix in slaw then set aside.
Add diced chicken thighs, salt, pepper, garlic powder and buffalo sauce to a large bowl and toss.
Pan sear over high heat until cooked through.
Load tortilla with buffalo chicken, ranch slaw and cheddar cheese.
Roll tightly and brown on all sides in a hot skillet.
Serve with extra buffalo sauce & enjoy!

title: Buffalo Ranch Chicken Skillet
description: ONE POT BUFFALO RANCH CHICKEN SKILLET 🔥 Done in 30 minutes, made in one pot, packed with veggies & tastes even better the next day for leftovers - the perfect weeknight meal!!!
ingredients: 3 cups shredded chicken (I prefer to use rotissare here!)
Green onion, ranch & buffalo sauce to top
steps: In a large pan over medium heat, add olive oil and mix onion, garlic, celery, bell pepper & shredded carrots until well combined and fork tender
Add garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper and ranch seasoning powder and mix well, then add shredded chicken, buffalo sauce, rice and chicken broth & bring to a simmer
Once simmering, cover and cook for another ~15 minutes until the rice is cooked through and has absorbed most of the liquid, stirring every 4-5 minutes to ensure the rice is cooking evenly
Add heavy cream and shredded cheddar cheese and mix until well combined

title: Butter Toffee Pretzels
description: The yummiest holiday treat, Butter Toffee Pretzels!
ingredients: 1 cup chocolate chips or extra toffee pieces like Heath (optional)
steps: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.
In a saucepan, melt the butter and brown sugar together, stirring continuously until it gently boils.
Add in the vanilla extract and continue to stir, allowing it to boil for one minute.
Spread your pretzels on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle the toffee mixture over the pretzels, coating them evenly.
Place them in the oven for 10-15 minutes until they are bubbly.
If you are adding chocolate chips or heath, do it while they are warm so the chocolate gets melty.
And let them cool.

title: Cajun Chicken Rice
description: Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice Recipe⬇️
ingredients: 🔥 1 cup dry rice, cook according to
steps: 🔥 Cajun Cream Sauce 2 tablespoons butter 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1/2 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream
Paprika, Cajun seasoning, & pinch of salt
How to make 👇
🔥 Season chicken well and heat a pan to medium high heat. Add Olive oil & butter to the hot pan. Cook chicken 6-8 minutes per side till golden brown and set aside.

🔥 To the same pan we want that flavor the chicken left behind!- add onion, pepper, & seasoning. Cook 3-4 minutes until soft. Add garlic mix well and cook for another minute or two. Add cooked rice and mix all the flavors together. Place the chicken back on top.

🔥To make the cream sauce add all the ingredients together a pot and bring to a boil, once boiling reduce the heat to medium low, stir often for about 5-6 minutes until desired thickness. Add cream cheese or Parmesan to make it thicker.
🔥 Pour cream sauce over chicken and rice and enjoy!!

title: Carrot Fritter
description: Easy baby led weaning and toddler lunch idea.
ingredients: 1 carrot(100g) cooked or grated finely raw
steps: Combine all ingredients and fry on a medium heat in butter/olive oil for a couple of minutes on each side.
BLW friendly from 6 months once allergens introduced

title: Cheeseburger Sliders are easy to make and the family loves them!
description: Cheeseburger Sliders are easy to make and the family loves them!
ingredients: 12 count King’s Hawaiian Original Sweet Rolls
1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper
1 tsp each of garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika
1/2 cup mayo, 1/4 cup ketchup, 1/8 cup mustard, 1 TBSP sweet relish
steps: Cook onion rings according the the directions on the package.
Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat with a chopped onion. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.

Once the ground beef is browned, drain any extra grease from the skillet and add the minced garlic. Slice King’s Hawaiian rolls in half and put the bottom of the rolls in a greased baking dish or on a sheet pan.
Add a layer of American cheese. Add the ground beef on top of the cheese. Top the ground beef with homemade burger sauce and shredded cheddar cheese. Add a crispy onion ring on top.
Put the tops of the slider rolls on and brush with melted butter. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top. Bake at 350 for about 10-15 minutes. Enjoy!!

title: Cheeseburger Stuffed Potatoes
description: Easy weeknight dinner 🤌 ✨My recipe is below✨ This is all your favorite things about a cheeseburger but stuffed into a potato 😍 My fiancé said out of all of the stuffed potatoes I’ve made (and if you follow me -you know that’s a lot), this is his favorite.
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded cheddar Spices- heavy pinch of garlic powder, paprika, oregano black pepper + salt
steps: Cook potato in oven for 50-60 min at 400, coated with a little oil and salt. Cut in half and scoop out insides leaving a little potato inside so it doesn’t get too flimsy.
In a bowl mix together the cooked potato with other ingredients. Top with extra cheddar cheese. Cook at 425 for 7-10 minutes or until cheese melts.
Add pickles, onions, tomato and more sauce. Enjoy! 🥔
This makes 2 potato halves so double up as needed!

title: Cheesy broccoli fritters
description: Yummy cheesy broccoli fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded cheese (cheddar, mozzarella, or your choice)
Olive oil or vegetable oil for frying
steps: Steam the Vegetables:
Steam potatoes for 10 minutes, then add broccoli and steam for another 5-8 minutes until tender.
Mash:
Mash the potatoes and broccoli together, leaving some chunks for texture.
Mix:
Stir in the cheese, egg, and flour to form a thick dough.
Form & cook:
Shape the mixture into patties.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add 1-2 tbsp oil. Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown

title: Chicken Tetrazzini Casserole
description: This easy chicken tetrazzini casserole is made with cooked chicken, spaghetti, spinach, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cheddar, and mozzarella. It’s creamy, cheesy, family-friendly, and a great way to use leftover chicken for an easy weeknight dinner.
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup (I love @PacificFoods)
1½ cups sour cream or Greek yogurt
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, chopped spinach, chicken, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Pour mixture into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove foil and top with cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
Bake for another 10 minutes, then broil for 2–4 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Slice and serve warm.

title: Cheesy Potato and Beef Skillet
description: Layers of creamy Yukon gold potatoes, seasoned ground beef, and melted cheddar cheese make this Cheesy Potato & Beef Skillet a comforting one-pan dinner the whole family will love. Rich, hearty, and easy to make, it's the perfect recipe for busy weeknights, cozy weekends, or anytime you're craving classic comfort food.
ingredients: 4 small yukon gold potatoes, (sliced thinly with mandolin)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350℉.

First, make the cream for the potatoes. Preheat an oven-safe pan to medium heat. Add the milk, onion powder, garlic powder, and dried rosemary. Stir everything together and bring to a simmer. Let it simmer for a few minutes, then add the parmesan cheese. Mix until the cheese has melted.
Turn off the heat, remove the cream from the pan, and place it into a bowl. Leave just a little bit of the cream in the bottom of the pan.
Add a layer of thinly sliced potatoes, then a layer of cream. Repeat until all the potatoes and cream are gone.
Cover with foil and place in the oven for 50 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked and can easily be pierced with a fork.

While the potatoes are cooking, make the ground beef mixture. Add the ground beef and cook for 7-10 minutes until brown. Add the diced onions and ground beef seasoning and saute for a few more minutes until the onions are soft.
Once the potatoes are out of the oven, top with the ground beef mixture and shredded cheese.
Place back into the oven and broil for 3-5 minutes until the cheese is golden brown. Top with sliced green onion and serve immediately. Enjoy!

title: Cheesy pumpkin rice balls
description: These cheesy pumpkin rice balls are the ultimate comfort snack for little ones and adults alike! With a soft, arancini-like centre and a crispy golden exterior, they’re packed with the naturally sweet and earthy flavors of pumpkin, balanced yummy melted cheese. The rice gives the balls a lovely soft texture, making them easy to hold and chew – ideal for babies and toddlers getting used to finger f
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
steps: Preheat your oven to 180°C/350°F.
Remove rind from your pumpkin, then cut into 1in/2cm pieces. Steam your butternut pumpkin until soft, then mash in a large bowl. Steaming will take 15-20 minutes for 1in/2cm pieces.
Add all remaining ingredients to the mashed pumpkin and mix well with a fork until fully combined.
Form the mixture into golf-sized balls. You should get about 18-20 rice balls, depending on size.
Place the balls on a lined baking tray and bake for 30 minutes.
Allow to cool slightly before enjoying. Store in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Cheesy Taco Spaghetti
description: Cheesy Taco Spaghetti This easy one-skillet Cheesy Taco Spaghetti combines all the flavors of tacos with creamy, cheesy pasta for a family-friendly dinner everyone will love!
ingredients: 1 cup freshly shredded Colby Jack cheese
1/3 cup sour cream Optional Toppings: Sliced green onions Additional shredded Colby Jack cheese
steps: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef, diced onion, and bell pepper until the beef is browned and the vegetables are tender. Drain any excess grease.
Stir in the taco seasoning, Rotel, and beef broth. Mix well to combine.
Add the spaghetti noodles, breaking them in half if needed. Press the noodles down so they are fully submerged in the liquid.

Cover and bring the mixture to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook according to the pasta package directions, stirring 2–3 times throughout cooking to prevent the noodles from sticking.
When the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, stir in the cream cheese, shredded Colby Jack cheese, and sour cream. Mix until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy.
Top with sliced green onions and additional Colby Jack cheese, if desired, and serve warm.

title: Chewy Pumpkin Cookies
description: These chewy pumpkin cookies have the perfect amount of pumpkin spice and each bite truly melts in your mouth. With chewy centers and spiced sugar topping, you will not believe how delicious these fall cookies are!
ingredients: 1 cup (220 g) light brown sugar, packed
1/2 cup (122 g) canned pumpkin puree (Libby's works best)
1 3/4 cups (219 g) all purpose flour, spooned and leveled
steps: In a small bowl mix the granulated sugar and pumpkin pie spice together. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

Start by drying your pumpkin. (This step is not optional. The cookies will not bake properly if you skip this step.) Spread the canned pumpkin on a plate and lightly press with a paper towel to absorb the excess liquid. Repeat the step at least four more times. The pumpkin should be dry enough that it goes from being 1/2 cup dried down to just about a 1/4 cup. Hardly any liquid should transfer onto a paper towel once it has been dried enough.(Like stated above, try to use Libby's canned pumpkin as almost all cans of it have the same consistency and are not too wet.) Then set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Set aside.
In a large bowl cream the softened butter and brown sugar together with an electric mixer on high speed for 1-2 minutes until light and fluffy.
Add in the egg yolks and vanilla and mix on medium speed until pale and fluffy, about 1-2 minutes.
Add in the pumpkin and mix on medium-low speed to combine.
Add in the dry ingredients and mix on low speed just until combined.

Scoop the dough with a 2 tbsp cookie scoop, and roll them into balls. Then roll the dough balls in the spiced sugar. (If the dough is too "sticky" chill it in the fridge for 10 minutes, then proceed.)
Place the cookie dough balls at least 2 inches apart on the baking sheets. (I usually bake 6 at a time.)

Bake the cookies for 12-14 minutes. (12 minutes for really chewy centers, 14 minutes for a slightly crispier cookie). When the cookies are done baking the centers will be puffy. As they cool the centers will fall and the cookie will get "wrinkly".
Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a cooling rack to finish cooling. They are best enjoyed when they have cooled for at least 15 minutes!

title: Dump and Bake Chicken Broccoli Alfredo Noodle Casserole
description: Simply dump, bake, and serve this creamy broccoli, chicken, and cheese casserole...cozy comfort in just one dish!
ingredients: 1 pound boneless chicken, cut into cubes
1 pound dry short cut pasta or egg noodles
fresh parsley or basil, for serving
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F.2. Melt the butter in a 9x13 inch baking dish with high sides. Add the chicken, 1 tablespoon Italian seasoning, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. 3. Arrange the noodles and broccoli over the raw chicken. Pour over 1 1/2 cups of water.4. Mix the melted cream cheese with the heavy cream. Whisk in the milk and the parmesan. Add additional Italian seasoning to taste. Evenly pour the cream mix over the noodles and broccoli. Top with cheese. Sprinkle with additional garlic powder. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Remove the lid and bake another 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is browning and the noodles on top are getting crispy. 5. Top with fresh chopped parsley or basil. Scoop and enjoy!

title: Chicken Alfredo Lasagna Roll Ups
description: Replying to @ally.1148
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (rotisserie or leftover) see note**
1 tsp garlic & herb seasoning @Fire & Smoke Society
steps: Cook the noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and lay flat on parchment paper or foil so they don’t stick.
Make the filling: In a bowl, combine Boursin cheese, ricotta, egg, garlic powder, black pepper, garlic & herb seasoning, and parsley. Mix until fully combined.

Make the Alfredo sauce: In a skillet or saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in Parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper until smooth and creamy.

Assemble: Spread 1/2 cup Alfredo sauce into the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish. Spoon the cheese mixture onto each lasagna noodle, followed by a spoon of chicken, then roll tightly. Place seam-side down in the dish.
Top it off: Pour remaining Alfredo sauce over the roll ups. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
Bake: Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 3 minutes on low broil until bubbly and golden.

Finish: Garnish with parsley and let rest 5 minutes before serving. Creamy, rich, and absolutely delicious—perfect for feeding the family or meal prepping leftovers. Note: I premade my chicken earlier in the week and seasoned with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.

title: Chicken Caesar Smash Burgers
steps: In a large bowl, mix together the ground chicken, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper until combined. Form into 4 patties.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the patties and gently press down with a spatula to flatten.
Cook for about 5-6 minutes per side, or until fully cooked through. Add cheese slices during the last minute of cooking and cover to melt.
While the burgers cook, whisk together the Greek yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, garlic, parmesan, salt, and pepper to make the Caesar dressing.
Set aside about half of the dressing to spread onto the buns. Toss the remaining dressing with the chopped romaine.
Toast the buns, spread the reserved Caesar dressing onto each bun, then add the chicken burger and Caesar salad mixture.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole
description: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole (550 cals + 50g protein) This recipe makes 7
ingredients: 3/4 cup, Swiss and Gruyere Shredded Cheese
1/4 cup Garlic and Herb Bread Crumbs
50 (5 spays) fluid ounce Olive Oil Spray
steps: Season to taste with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika.

title: Chicken Maple Sausage
description: Homemade chicken maple breakfast sausage!!
ingredients: 1 tsp poultry seasoning (trust me on this one!)
1/4 tsp each: paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin
1 tsp kosher salt (use a little less if you just have table salt)
steps: Mix together all ingredient except the olive oil in a bowl. Form into 6 patties (or link-shaped sausages).
tip: if you want to test it out, just add about 1 tbsp of the chicken mixture to a pan. Cook it through and adjust seasonings to your personal preference!
To a pan on medium heat, add the olive oil. Once heated, add the sausage patties. Cook for about 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve with your favorite breakfast dishes!

title: Chicken Nuggies
description: Easy 3-Ingredient Chicken Nuggies 🐓 Ingredients: - 1 Package of Ground Chicken (16 oz) - 2 eggs - 1 cup ground sourdough crackers (or bread crumbs) - Salt and pepper
ingredients: 1 cup ground sourdough crackers (or bread crumbs)
steps: Salt and pepper
EVOO Recipe:
Preheat oven to 400 Degrees F
Crack eggs into large bowl
Add in ground chicken, salt and pepper, and mash together
Grind up sourdough crackers in a blender or food processor
Take a spoonful of chicken, dip into cracker mixture, and then place on baking sheet
Add EVOO on top
Bake for about 20 minutes (flip halfway) until golden brown and chicken is cooked through
Serve with your fav sauces

title: Chicken Taco Bowls
description: Chicken Taco Bowls w Creamy Chipotle Sauce!
ingredients: Crock pot for 4 hours on low or 2 ish hours on high
steps: Stir as needed. Shred Chicken when fork tender. RICE 5C Dry Rice, rinsed 9oz Chicken Bone Broth
Saute pan, bring to boil, cover, lower to simmer, cook 15 min covered. Remove from heat and let steam for 10 min. Ready CREAMY CHIPOTLE SAUCE 16oz Greek Yogurt
Juice of 2 Limes 3 Chipotle Peppers 1-2T of Adobo Sauce 5T Honey 2T Avocado Oil 1/4C Milk
Cilantro and Salt as you wish
Add all to blender and make your sauce
Add cooked Rice to crock pot, mix well
Serve and top with Chipotle Sauce
Easy, Good and Healthy!
Enjoy

title: Chicken Tzatziki Salad
description: This vibrant salad is hearty enough to be called a meal. It's delicious and full of color - great any night!
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs, cubed
chili flakes, salt, and black pepper
4-5 cups shredded kale and/or romaine mixed
1 cup mixed herbs: basil, dill, parsley
steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425° F.2. On a baking sheet, toss the chicken, 2 tablespoons olive oil, chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, honey, and season to taste with chili flakes, salt, and pepper. Toss well to evenly coat. Roast for 15-20 minutes, until lightly chard.3. Add the kale/romaine, cucumbers, and sun-dried tomatoes to a large salad bowl.4. To make the dressing. Combine all ingredients in a blender or glass jar and blend/whisk until smooth. Add 1/4 to 1/2 cup water to thin the dressing. Taste and season with chili flakes and additional salt.5. Pour some of the dressing over the salad, massaging the dressing into the kale. Add the chicken, avocado, feta, herbs, and sesame seeds. Top the salad with lots of Tzakiki and extra dressing. Lightly toss. Serve and enjoy!

title: Chili Crisp Beef Bowls with Coconut Broth
description: if you’re needing to add another quick & easy + budget friendly meal to your dinner rotation, try these Chili Crisp Beef Bowls with Coconut Broth.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili crisp (less if sensitive to spice)
Diced cucumber, for garnish Chili crisp, for garnish (optional)
steps: Cook rice according to package directions, adjusting portion sizes as needed.

Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Drizzle with oil, then add the ground beef, breaking it into small pieces as it browns. Once the beef is almost fully cooked, add the pepper, onion and garlic and sauté until softened.

Mix together the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, chili crisp, ginger powder and broth then add to the beef mixture, stirring to combine. Reduce the heat and allow the sauce to slightly cook down. If needed, season with salt.
For the broth, add coconut milk, soy sauce, chili crisp and ginger to a sauce pan. Bring to a boil and stir to combine all ingredients.
Assemble bowls by adding rice, then topping with beef, broth, cucumbers.

title: Chocolate Brownies with Cream Cheese Frosting
description: If you’re a chocolate lover, these Chocolate Brownies with Cream Cheese Frosting might just be your new obsession
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and line an 8×8-inch pan with parchment paper.
Brown the butter in a saucepan over medium heat until it smells nutty and golden. Remove from heat. Stir in sugars and cocoa powder. Let cool 5 min.
Add vanilla, then whisk in eggs one at a time until glossy and smooth.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt until just combined. Stir in chocolate chips.
Spread into pan and smooth the top. Bake 32–36 minutes or until set with a slight jiggle in the center. Cool completely.
Meanwhile, make the frosting: Beat cream cheese and butter until creamy. Add cocoa powder, powdered sugar, vanilla, and salt. Beat until fluffy, adding milk/cream as needed.
Frost cooled brownies, then chill for 30 minutes for cleaner cuts.

title: Chocolate Caramel Clusters
description: FULL RECIPE IN CAPTION !!
steps: to a bowl add your chopped dates, greek yogurt, nut butter, maple syrup, sea salt and mix until combined to a parchment lined baking tray, scoop your yogurt caramel mixture to whatever size you prefer and form into little patties. they won’t be perfect but it will taste delish.
freeze for 1-2 hours and then dip in melted dark chocolate. place the chocolate covered clusters back on your parchment lined tray.
sprinkle sea salt over top & put back in the freezer until your chocolate shell is hardened.
enjoy! these are a must try

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Cookies
description: Throwing out ripe bananas is a serious no-no in my book. Don't do it! Make cookies instead! These Easy Chocolate Chip Banana Cookies are sure to become a new favorite - so soft and delicious, they're impossible to resist!
steps: Whisk together the flour, baking soda, corn starch, and salt in a medium bowl and set aside.
Cream butter, bananas, and sugars together until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla extract until combined.
Stir in the flour mixture just until combined. Stir in chocolate chips.
Refrigerate dough for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375F. Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper or lightly spray with cooking spray.
Use a cookie scoop to scoop out cookie dough onto prepared cookie sheets.
Bake cookies for 9-10 minutes or just until they start to turn light, golden brown on top.
Let cookies cool completely on cookie sheets.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake Bites
description: • 2 boxes cake mix (usually white!) • 4 eggs • 2 cups chocolate chips (or sprinkles, m&ms, anything you like!) • 2 sticks melted butter
ingredients: 2 cups chocolate chips (or sprinkles, m&ms, anything you like!)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350.
Spray an 9x13 baking pan with oil spray. Spray it WELL! You want them to be able to come right out of the pan later!

Combine all four ingredients until well mixed. The batter will be THICK, and you’ll have to use some elbow grease to get it out of the mixer, but this is when you know the consistency is right on the money!
Spread evenly in baking dish! To make this easier, I usually spray my clean hands with a little cooking spray and press evenly, works like a charm!
Bake for 30 minutes, then start checking on them! Every oven will vary, you just want the top golden!
Immediately chill in the fridge for TWO hours; this will allow the bites to set up before you cut them!
7 Cut into bite sized pieces, and enjoy!

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake
description: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake!
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, or vegan butter or coconut oil
2/3 cup @lakanto monkfruit & erythritol sweetened chocolate chips
steps: Whisk together dry ingredients
Add in softened butter, syrup, and vanilla and mix with a hand mixer until well combined
Fold in most of the chocolate chips, reserving some for topping
Line the bottom of an 8" round pan with parchment paper (I traced the pan then cut), and spray with nonstick avocado or coconut oil spray
Bake at 350 for 16 min Allow to cool completely, about an hour, before removing from pan. I found placing in the fridge for the later 20-30 min helped
Use a butter knife to seperate cookie from the edges, then invert the cookie cake onto a plate to remove without breaking Optionally, top with frosting and more chocolate chips Slice and enjoy!

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies Recipe
description: Honestly some of the best cookies I’ve ever made.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips & some chopped chocolate
steps: add the butter into a saucepan over medium-high heat. allow it to melt and brown ~ should take around 5-8 minutes. set it aside to cool for 15 min in a medium bowl whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. set it aside once the brown butter has cooled, add both sugars and whisk until combined.
add in the eggs and whisk until combined. whisk in the vanilla.
add the dry ingredients to the wet, and fold with a spatula until barely combined.
add in your chocolate chips/chunks use a large cookie scoop to scoop the dough onto a prepared baking sheet.
cover the sheet with plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 15 minutes.
preheat the oven to 350 F once ready to bake, bake them at 350F for 14 minutes.
allow them to cool and then enjoy :)

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
description: Higher protein sweet treat my kids actually love!
ingredients: 2 (15.5 oz) cans Black Beans, drained and rinsed, or 2¼ cup Cooked Black Beans
½ cup Maple Syrup, or Honey (use
⅓ cup Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips, sugar free or any kind you love, optional
steps: Preheat oven to 350° F and line a muffin tin with liners.

In a food processor or blender, blend together black beans and 1 egg until combined. Add remaining eggs, maple syrup, cocoa powder, oil, vanilla, baking powder, and salt and blend until completely combined, scraping the sides as needed. Stir in chocolate chips.

Pour batter evenly into prepared muffin tin and sprinkle with additional chocolate chips, if desired. Bake at 350° F for 25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out mostly clean. Allow to cool for 5 minutes in the muffin tin. Remove to a cooling rack and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Serve and enjoy! Notes
Muffins can be frozen in an airtight container for up to 3 months. When ready to eat, cook in the microwave for 30 seconds or until warmed through.

title: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Cookie Pie
description: Step aside pumpkin pie, this chocolate chip peanut butter cookie pie is the star of your thanksgiving dessert spread this year!
ingredients: ¾ cup light brown sugar, packed
3/4 cup Bakers’ Corner All Purpose Flour
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and place the Belmont Deep Dish Pie Crust on a cookie sheet. Set aside.
In a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine the eggs, brown sugar, and granulated sugar.
Beat on medium speed until light and fluffy and pale yellow in color, about 2 minutes.
Add the peanut butter, melted butter, and vanilla extract and beat on medium speed until smooth and combined, about 30 seconds.
Add the flour and salt and mix to combine. Last, add the chocolate chips, using a silicone spatula to fold into the batter.
Spoon the peanut butter cookie batter into the pie crust, spreading into an even layer.
Bake until the pie is golden brown all over and only wiggles slightly in the center when you jostle the pan, 30 to 45 minutes.
Let the pie cool for at least 1 hour before slicing and serving!

title: CHOCOLATE CHIP PUMPKIN BAKED OATMEAL
description: CHOCOLATE CHIP PUMPKIN BAKED OATMEAL INGREDIENTS:
ingredients: 1¼ cups milk (I like ultra-filtered for some extra protein)
½ tsp cinnamon or pumpkin pie spice
½ tsp salt Handful of dark chocolate chips (optional) RECIPE:
steps: Mash one banana in a large mixing bowl.
Add all wet ingredients (1/2 cup pumpkin puree, 1 1/4 cups milk, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp vanilla) and mix well.
Add all dry ingredients (2.5 cups rolled oats, 4 tbsp hemp hearts, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt) and mix well.
Add mixture to an 8x8 baking dish lined with parchment paper and sprinkle dark chocolate chips on top. (Can also do chopped walnuts or pecans here for a crunch!)

Bake at 350 degrees for ~30 minutes. I loooove cutting slices of this for an easy snack or breakfast option during the week. It's delish warmed up in the microwave and topped with some nut butter and extra hemp hearts. Enjoy!

title: Chocolate Coconut Cookies
description: These are seriously so delicious😋 * 1 cup pitted medjool dates, about 10 dates * 1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut * 1/3 cup dark chocolate * 1/2 teaspoon coconut oil 1.
ingredients: 1 cup pitted medjool dates, about 10 dates
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread the shredded coconut onto a baking sheet for toasting. Place in oven for 3-5 minutes
Add dates and toasted coconut into the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until mixture is combined and starts to form a ball of dough.
Roll 1 Tablespoon size pieces of dough into a ball and then shape into a round cookie. Using a straw or chopstick punch a hole in the middle of the dough.
Let cookies harden in the freezer
Add chocolate and coconut oil to a bowl and melt in 20-30 second increments until the chocolate is melted
Dip each cookie in the chocolate to coat the bottom. Place cookies on the parchment and use remaining chocolate to drizzle over top the cookies.

title: Chocolate Cookie Mousse
description: High-protein chocolate cookie mousse!
ingredients: 2 tbsp maple syrup or honey (optional – depends on how sweet your protein powder is) Cookies of choice
1 tsp coconut oil Sea salt (for topping)
steps: Add cottage cheese, protein powder, and sweetener to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour back into cottage cheese container
Stir in crushed cookies and smooth out the top. Add extra crushed cookies on top

In a bowl, add chocolate chips and coconut oil. Microwave 30 sec, stir, and repeat until smooth. Pour chocolate over top of the cottage cheese mousse and spread evenly. Add sea salt. Freeze until chocolate shell has hardened (10-15 min) Keep stored in the fridge for a pudding consistency or freezer for an ice cream consistency. If freezing, let thaw 5-10 min before eating – enjoy!

title: chocolate covered strawberry date bark 💌🍓🍫 recipe below!
description: chocolate covered strawberry date bark 💌🍓🍫 recipe below!
steps: start by removing the pits from all of your dates. Line them up on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Then cover with another piece of parchment and roll them out.
Top with your almond butter. Spread into a nice and even layer. Pop in the freezer while we prep the strawberries.
Add your strawberries over top. Then in a microwave safe bowl, add your mini chocolate chips and coconut oil. Melt until smooth ~45-60 seconds.
Pour the chocolate over top of the strawberries. Spread into an even layer.
Top with flaky salt if desired !
Then pop back in the freezer to fully set ~1-2 hours.
Remove from freezer, cut into bars and serve ENJOY!!! 🫶🏼💌🍓🍫
I recommend storing in the freezer & enjoy within 1 month!

title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
description: Chocolate fudge pie 🤎 recipe below 👇🏼
ingredients: 3 tbsp maple syrup (or corn syrup, which is my grandmother’s way)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Place the butter and chocolate in a pot on the lowest heat setting. Slowly allow to melt while whisking occasionally. Once melted, remove from burner and allow to cool slightly.
Add eggs to a large bowl and whisk vigorously for about 2 minutes.
Add the maple syrup, sugar, flour, salt and vanilla to the eggs and whisk to combine fully.
Once combined, add in the melted chocolate. Whisk until just combined.
Pour the pie filling into a raw store bought or homemade pie shell.
Place pie into the oven on the middle rack. Cook for about 45 minutes to an hour.

Note: The pie should be set on the edges and slightly giggly in the center when done. I’ve cooked this pie in a few different ovens and the cook time always differs. Sometimes it’s 45 min and sometimes it’s 55 min. So keep an eye on the pie towards the end of cooking time.
Allow pie to cool for an hour before eating. Serve with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Snack
description: this is your childhood snack, grown up.
ingredients: 3 rice cakes, broken into bite-size pieces
steps: Melt chocolate and stir in peanut butter until smooth.
Add broken rice cake pieces to a large bag or bowl and pour chocolate mixture over top.
Toss to coat evenly.
Add powdered monk fruit, and shake until fully coated.
Enjoy right away or store in the fridge for extra crunch.

title: Christmas Monster Cookies
description: Festive, easy, and sweet...these cookies are perfect for packing up and gifting for the holidays!
ingredients: 2 sticks (1 cup) salted butter at room temperature
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips or chunks
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350° F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.2. In a large mixing bowl, beat together the butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, and vanilla until combined. Beat in the eggs and 1 egg yolk, 1 at a time, until combined. Add the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Beat in the oats. 3. Fold in 1 cup of the M&M's, the pretzels, chocolate chips, and white chocolate. 4. Roll the dough into 1/4 cup size balls. Place 3 inches apart on the prepared baking sheet. 5. Transfer to the oven and bake for 8 minutes, then rotate the pan and bake another 2 minutes. Pull the pan out and push the remaining M&M's into the cookies. Bake 2-3 minutes. Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet. They will continue to cook slightly as they sit on the baking sheet. 6. Eat warm (highly recommended) or let cool and store in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

title: Christmas Sugar Cookie Bars
description: These Christmas Sugar Cookie Bars are everything you love about classic sugar cookies (soft, sweet, buttery, and full of holiday sprinkles) but without all the rolling and cutting. They bake in one pan and are topped with creamy vanilla frosting. A perfect, low-stress, nostalgic treat for holiday parties and cookie exchanges!
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened to room temperature)
4 oz cream cheese (softened to room temperature)
1/8 cup Christmas sprinkles (jimmies, plus more for garnish)
1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened to room temperature)
1 ½ Tbsp heavy cream (room temperature; add more as needed)
steps: Preheat Oven: Preheat to 325°F. Spray a 9×13-inch pan with non stick spray, and then line with parchment paper. This makes it easy for the parchment to stick to the pan when you spread the bars later on.

Cream Butter, Cream Cheese & Sugar: In a large mixing bowl or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter, cream cheese, and granulated sugar together on medium speed until light and creamy, about 2–3 minutes. Start Timer
Add Wet Ingredients: Mix in the egg, egg yolk, vanilla, and almond extract (if using) until smooth and well combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.

Add Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and baking soda. Gradually add to the wet ingredients on low speed until a soft dough forms. It will be pretty soft, and not like a normal dry-ish cookie dough texture. We want soft, that’s good!
Add sprinkles: Fold in the Christmas sprinkles.

Spread and Bake: Press the dough evenly into the prepared pan with an offset spatula. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden and the center looks just set. (It’s crucial for these bars to not overbake, they’ll continue to firm as they cool and we want them soft and chewy!) Start Timer
Cool: Allow bars to cool completely in the pan on a wire rack before frosting.

Make the Frosting: In a medium bowl, beat the butter until smooth. Add the vanilla, almond extract (if using), and salt. Gradually mix in the powdered sugar until combined, then add the heavy cream and beat for 1-2 minutes until light and fluffy. Tint with food coloring, if desired. (Example: A couple drops of red for a pretty pink color, or green for Christmas)
Frost & Decorate: Spread frosting evenly over cooled cookie bars and top with additional sprinkles. Slice into squares and enjoy!

title: Chuck Roast Elote Tacos
description: Chuck Roast Elote Tacos Ingredients For the Chuck Roast • 3–4 lb chuck roast • Coarse salt • Coarse black pepper For the Elote Corn • 3 cups frozen corn • 1–2 tbsp oil • ¼ cup sour cream • ¼ cup mayonnaise • ½ tsp chili powder • ½ tsp garlic powder • Salt, to taste For Assembly • Corn tor
ingredients: Coarse black pepper For the Elote Corn
steps: Cook the Chuck Roast Preheat the oven to 325°F. Season the roast generously on all sides with coarse salt and coarse pepper. Place it in a baking dish, cover tightly with foil, and bake for about 1 hour per pound, until tender and shreddable.
Shred & Broil Remove the foil, shred the roast, and toss the meat in the rendered fat. Spread the shredded beef on the pan and broil for a few minutes until the edges are crispy.

Char the Elote Corn Heat a large pan over high heat with a little oil. Add frozen corn in a single layer and cook for about 3 minutes without touching it to develop char. Toss, then cook another 1–2 minutes. Stir in sour cream, mayo, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt.
Toast the Tortillas Warm or lightly toast corn tortillas in a dry pan until soft and slightly crisp around the edges.

Assemble the Tacos Spread a little avocado mayo on each tortilla, add crispy chuck roast, spoon the elote corn on top, and finish with queso fresco and fresh cilantro. #dinnerideas #chuckroast #dinnerrecipes ##weeknightdinner#

title: Chuck Roast Tacos
description: Chuck Roast Tacos!!
steps: Combine corn
Mayo Green yogurt
Cilantro
Green onion
Lime
Chili powder
I never measure anything. Mix together and put on top of tacos!!

title: Crockpot Chuck Roast Tinga Tacos
description: Slow-cooked, smoky, and packed with flavor, these tacos are perfect for Cinco de Mayo or any taco night!
ingredients: 12 hard or soft taco shells, warmed
cilantro, green onion, avocado, and crumbled cotija cheese, for serving
1/2 cup mayo or plain Greek yogurt
steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 325°F.2. Arrange the onions in the bottom of a large, oven-safe Dutch oven.3. In a bowl, mix the garlic, chipotle powder, oregano, cumin, and season with salt. Rub the roast all over with the spice mix, then place it on top of the onions. Pour over the enchilada sauce, add the chipotle peppers in in adobo, 3/4 cup water, and the butter. Cover and roast for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until very tender.4. Crank the heat up on the oven to 425°F. Uncover and cook for 10 minutes until deeply caramelized on top. Remove the meat from the pot and shred it using two forks.5. To make the Cilantro Lime Yogurt Sauce, combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse until combined. Do not puree or the sauce will be thin. Season with salt.6. Stuff the beef and onions into the warmed taco shells and top with crema, cilantro, avocado, and cheese. Serve with the braising liquid. Enjoy!

Place the roast over the onions, then rub all over with the spice mix. Pour over the enchilada sauce, add the chipotle peppers in in adobo and the butter. Cover and cook on LOW for 5 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours.3. Remove the meat from the crockpot and shred it using two forks.4. To make the Cilantro Lime Yogurt Sauce, combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse until combined. Do not puree or the sauce will be thin. Season with salt.5. Stuff the beef and onions into the warmed taco shells and top with crema, cilantro, avocado, and cheese. Serve with the braising liquid. Enjoy!

title: cilantro lime chicken thighs with mango salsa & coconut rice 🍚 🍋‍🟩✨🥭
description: cilantro lime chicken thighs with mango salsa & coconut rice 🍚 🍋‍🟩✨🥭 What you’ll need: For the chicken: 1 ½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs 2 tbsp avocado oil Zest of 1 and juice of 2 limes 3 cloves garlic, minced ½ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped 2 tbsp Greek yogurt 2 tbsp honey 1 tsp gro
ingredients: For the chicken: 1 ½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs
2 tbsp avocado oil Zest of 1 and juice of 2 limes
½ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped
1 cup jasmine rice For the coconut rice: 1 cup jasmine rice
2 tbsp chopped cilantro For the mango salsa: 1 ripe mango, diced
1/4 cup cilantro, chopped Juice of 1 lime Salt to taste
steps: In a medium bowl, combine cilantro, garlic, avocado oil, lime zest and juice, Greek yogurt, honey, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs and toss until fully coated.
Cover and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
While the chicken marinates, prepare the coconut rice.
Add jasmine rice, coconut milk, and salt to a pot.
Cook according to the package instructions until the rice is tender and creamy.
Once cooked, stir in the chopped cilantro.
To make the mango salsa, add diced mango, red bell pepper, red onion, jalapeño, and cilantro to a bowl.
Squeeze in lime juice, season with salt, and mix until well combined.
Once the chicken has finished marinating, heat a skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until golden and fully cooked through, flipping halfway through, about 5 to 7 minutes per side.
No additional oil is needed.
Serve the chicken over the coconut rice and top with fresh mango salsa.

title: Cinnamon Roll Baked Oats
description: Cinnamon roll baked oats with 25g of protein!
ingredients: 1 cup egg whites (see notes for alternatives)
3 cups plain Greek yogurt (non-fat (half for the batter and half for topping))
¼ cup monk fruit maple syrup sweetener (or regular maple syrup)
¼ cup coconut sugar (or brown sugar) Prep:
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and grease a 9x13 baking dish. Mix: In the baking dish, mix all the ingredients together except for the melted butter, coconut sugar, and half the Greek yogurt. In a small bowl, mix the melted butter and coconut sugar. Dollop this over the top of the oat mixture evenly. Bake: Bake for 30-35 minutes or until all the liquid has absorbed. Enjoy: Let it cool slightly, then cut it into 6 large slices (I know, big, beautiful servings). Enjoy with a dollop of the remaining Greek yogurt (about ¼ cup per slice).

title: Cinnamon Rolls
description: If you don’t want to throw away your discard, these are delicious and only take 30 minutes!
steps: Add in 1/2 cup start 1/2 cup milk 1 tsp vanilla 1 egg Mix ingredients then pour into floured surface and roll out Spread 1/2 cup of melted butter across surface of dough Sprinkle cinnamon and brown sugar mixture on top of buttered dough and roll
Use floss or string to cut inch thick rolls Place in greased pan and bake for 16 minutes While rolls bake combine 1/2 cup butter 3 oz cream cheese 5 cups powdered sugar 1 tsp vanilla
Frost rolls while still warm:)
Recipe adapted from hopewellheights

title: Cinnamon Toast Crunch banana bread
description: Cinnamon Toast Crunch banana bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cup @kingarthurbaking all purpose flour (sub gluten free
steps: Start by preheating your oven to 350F And a large bowl or @kitchenaidusa stand mixer add your right bananas and mash until completely smooth. Once bananas are mashed add in your melted butter and sugar and mix to combined. Lastly, add in your Greek yogurt and eggs and mix until all is incorporated.
Slowly add in your dry ingredients and fold until completely combined. Set aside and make your cinnamon crunch topping.

Combine your melted butter, sugar, flour, and cinnamon in a small bowl and mix until combined. In a lined loaf tin add your batter and top with your cinnamon crunch. Place in the oven on 350F for 55-60 minutes. Make sure you check your banana bread to ensure it’s cooked through. All ovens are different and mine cooked for 62 minutes.
