title: Clean Thin Mints
description: Clean Thin Mints✨ If you want a healthier and clean version of your favorite Girl Scout cookie, stop and save this one!
steps: Whisk together the almond flour, cocoa powder and salt. Mix in the syrup, coconut oil and mint extract until combined and a rough dough forms. Shape the dough into a disc and cover in plastic wrap. Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour to overnight.

Roll out the dough between two pieces of parchment paper to 1/4 inch thick. Cut out circles with a 2 inch diameter. You should get about 12 with some scraps. Bake on 350F for 9-11 minutes until firm. Do not overbake as they burn easily. Let cool completely.

Melt the chocolate and coconut oil in the microwave in 20 second increments, stirring in between. Stir in the mint extract. Drop the cookies in the chocolate covering both sides, shake off excess and place back on the baking sheet. Top with sea salt if desired. Refrigerate until the chocolate hardens and enjoy!
use dairy free chocolate chips to make these vegan

title: Coconut Chicken Curry
description: Crockpot Creamy Coconut Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 tbsp garlic powder or 3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ground ginger or freshly grated ginger
Jasmine rice or cauliflower rice, for serving
steps: 1️⃣ In a crockpot, whisk together 1 can coconut milk, ¼ cup chicken broth, 3 tbsp creamy peanut butter, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp garlic powder, and 1 tbsp ground ginger.
2️⃣ Stir in 1½ tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp ground turmeric, a few shakes of freshly ground black pepper, and 1 tsp salt.
3️⃣ Add chicken, 1 bag diced sweet potatoes, 2 medium sliced carrots, and 1 diced yellow onion. Gently stir to coat everything in the sauce.
4️⃣ Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6–7 hours.
5️⃣ Remove the chicken, shred with two forks, and return it to the crockpot.
6️⃣ Stir in 1 sliced red bell pepper, cover, and cook on high for 10 more minutes until the peppers are tender yet still have a little crunch.
7️⃣ Serve over jasmine rice or cauliflower rice, and top with chopped parsley if desired.
Serves 5
Enjoy! ❤️

title: Coconut Curry Salmon with Garlic Butter
description: Simple, wholesome, and delicious...the perfect (non-boring) recipe to keep weeknight dinners fun!
ingredients: 2-3 tablespoons spicy curry powder ((homemade in notes) )
steps: 1. Preheat the broiler. 2. Place the salmon on a baking sheet and rub with olive oil, curry powder, and season with salt and pepper. Drizzle the honey over the salmon. Broil until crisping on top, 3-5 minutes, watch closely. 3. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt together 1 tablespoon butter, the curry paste, and ginger. Cook, 2-3 minutes until very fragrant. Add the broccoli, coconut milk, tamari or soy sauce, and fish sauce. Slide the salmon into the sauce and simmer for 3-5 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.4. Meanwhile, melt together 5 tablespoons butter, the garlic, and a pinch of chili flakes. Cook until the butter is browning and the garlic crisps. 5. Serve the salmon and sauce over bowls of rice. Drizzle the butter over the salmon and top with basil or cilantro.

title: cookie dough date bites 🍪🍫
description: cookie dough date bites 🍪🍫 What you’ll need: 15 dates, pitted For the cookie dough mixture: 1/2 cup coconut flour 1/3 cup runny peanut butter 2 tbsp maple syrup 1 tsp vanilla 1/4 cup chocolate chips 2-3 tbsp milk For the chocolate topping: 1/2 cup chocolate chips 1 tbsp coconut oil Flaky sea sal

2-3 tbsp milk For the chocolate topping: 1/2 cup chocolate chips

Line a plate or small baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice each date open, press them flat, then add them to the plate.
Scoop the cookie dough mixture into each date, dividing it evenly.
In a small bowl, combine the chocolate chips and coconut oil. Microwave in 30 second intervals, stirring between each, until fully melted and smooth.
Drizzle or spoon the melted chocolate over each stuffed date, then finish with flaky sea salt.

title: Crawfish Rice!! 🦞
description: Crawfish Rice!!
ingredients: 2 cups white rice (I used the rice cooker cup that comes with the rice pot. It is a little smaller than a traditional measuring cup)
steps: Add the rice, chopped bell pepper, garlic, diced shallot, beef consommé, melted butter, crawfish tails, Britscookin Cajun Seasoning, hot sauce, and black pepper to a rice cooker.
Give everything a good mix so the rice and crawfish are evenly combined.
Close the lid and set your rice cooker to the regular white rice setting.
Once the rice cooker finishes, fluff the rice with a fork.
Top with sliced green onions and serve.

title: Cream Cheese Sugar Cookies
description: This is the best sugar cookie recipe for Christmas! These cream cheese sugar cookies bake into a deliciously soft and buttery texture, but still hold their shape when baked. The dough only chills for one hour, or it can be prepped the day before and chill overnight. Spread some cream cheese buttercream on top for easy decorating. It dries firm, so these cookies can be stacked and stored - a must f
ingredients: 6 oz (170g) full fat cream cheese, room temperature
3 1/2 cups (450g) all-purpose flour, spooned and leveled, plus more for dusting
2 oz full fat cream cheese, room temp
2 cups (220g) powdered sugar, spooned and leveled
steps: In a large bowl using a hand or stand mixer with the paddle attachment, mix the butter, cream cheese, and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 1 minute.
Scrape down the bowl and mix in the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla until smooth.
Scrape down the bowl and mix in the salt, baking powder, and cream of tartar until combined.

Last, mix in the flour. When your mixer starts to struggle with the thick dough, remove from the mixer and use a rubber spatula to ensure the dough is well combined. It’s VERY thick and sticky, so this requires a little elbow grease!
Dump the dough out onto a sheet of plastic wrap lightly dusted with flour.
Coat your hands in flour and pat the dough out into a 1” thick rectangle. Wrap and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.
When ready, preheat the oven to 350F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll the dough out onto a floured surface to ¼” thick (we want nice and thick cookies).
Cut out as many cookies as you can and place them about an inch apart on the baking sheet. With any leftover cut out cookies, store in the refrigerator.

Bake for 8-10 minutes (9 was the sweet spot for me), or until they look dry on the surface but just barely done in the middle. In the meantime, you can re-roll the dough scraps, continuing to store any cut out cookies in the refrigerator until it’s time to bake them.
Let the cookies rest on the pan for about a minute, then transfer to a cooling rack before baking the rest of the batch.
In a large bowl using a hand or stand mixer with the paddle attachment, mix the butter and cream cheese until smooth.
Mix in the powdered sugar one cup at a time, followed by the vanilla. It should be thick and smooth. Mix in a few drops of gel food coloring if desired.
Spread the frosting on the cooled cookies and immediately top with sprinkles. If you wait too long, the sprinkles won’t stick so frost one cookie, add sprinkles, then move on to the next.
Now they’re ready to enjoy!

title: Creamy Beef Orzo
description: Fall meal prep is back & better than ever!!
steps: Add olive oil, garlic and onion to a large pot and let cook on medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until onions are slightly softened. Push onions to the edge of the pot and add beef — season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and Italian seasoning.

Once beef is cooked, add orzo, marinara, bone broth, and Worcestershire. Bring to a simmer, cover, and let cook for ~10 minutes or until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is cooked (stirring occasionally). Add cream, parmesan and spinach. Let cook for another 5 minutes or until thick. Top with extra parm & enjoy!

title: Creamy Boursin Spinach Chicken Bake
description: Family favorite chicken dinner that never has leftovers.
ingredients: 1 to 2 tbps Kinder’s Buttery Steakhouse seasoning
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Add fresh spinach directly into the bottom of the baking dish and spread it out.
Place chicken breasts on top of the spinach and season well with Kinder’s Buttery Steakhouse seasoning.
Spoon or dab Boursin cheese over each chicken breast.
Sprinkle minced garlic evenly over the dish.
In a small bowl, mix panko and Parmesan, then sprinkle over the chicken.
Pour heavy cream evenly into the dish around the chicken.
Bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes, or until chicken reaches 165°F and the top is golden.

title: Baked berry pancakes
description: This baked berry pancake recipe is so easy to make, with plenty of healthy ingredients and no refined sugar. It's as simple as blending a few ingredients together, stirring in flour, topping with berries and baking. No standing over the stove! You can also cook this ahead of time, and serve it up throughout the week (hot or cold). It's a great baby-led weaning starter food or toddler snack.
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
ingredients: I used berries, but you can use banana and chocolate chips or other fruit
steps: Use soft butter to grease your baking dish.
Place all blender ingredients in a blender and blend until there are no lumps.
Add blender ingredients to your baking dish and add dry ingredients (flour and baking powder). And stir to combine.

Top with your toppings (I used strawberries, blueberries and raspberries) and bake at 180C for 40-45 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. If you have a large dish, resulting in a relatively flat pancake, check it at 30 minutes. You may also need to top with aluminium foil around the halfway mark if beginning to brown.

title: Bakery-Style Chewy M&M Cookies
description: Ultra chewy cookies loaded with mini m&ms, deep dark brown sugar notes and a finish of flaky sea salt
ingredients: 1 cup Unsalted butter ((226 g), room temperature)
3/4 cup Dark brown sugar ((165 g), packed)
1/2 tbsp Vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract ((7.5 ml))
1 1/2 cups Mini M&Ms ((approx. 260 g), plus extra for placing on top)
steps: Whisk the Dry Ingredients: In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until completely combined and free of lumps. Set this dry mixture aside.

Cream the Butter and Sugars: In a large mixing bowl (or using a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), combine the room-temperature unsalted butter, packed dark brown sugar, and granulated sugar. Beat vigorously on medium-high speed for 2 to 3 minutes until the mixture is light, fluffy, and smooth.

Incorporate Eggs and Vanilla: Add the room-temperature eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition to fully incorporate them. Add the vanilla bean paste (or vanilla extract) and beat until the mixture is thick, velvety, and uniform.

Fold and Combine: Pour your dry ingredient mixture into the wet base. Using a wooden spoon or a rubber spatula, gently fold the ingredients together just until the flour disappears—do not overmix! Dump in your 1 1/2 cups of mini M&Ms and gently fold them into the cookie dough until evenly distributed.

Weigh and Prep the Dough: Preheat your oven to 350°F (177°C). Using a digital kitchen scale, weigh out 2.5-ounce (approx. 70 g) dough balls. Roll them smoothly between your hands. For that absolute bakery-quality look, press extra mini M&Ms directly onto the tops of the dough balls before they go into the oven.

Bake: Place dough balls on parchment-lined baking sheets, leaving about 2 to 3 inches of space between each cookie. Bake the cookies for 13 to 14 minutes. They are ready when the edges are a beautiful golden brown, but the insides are still slightly wet and soft.

The Finishing Touch: The second you pull the baking sheet out of the oven, take more mini M&Ms and immediately fill in any empty spaces on top of the hot, soft cookies. Sprinkle generously with flaky sea salt while they are warm. Allow them to cool on the pan for 10 minutes to set before transferring them to a wire rack.

title: Cheesy broccoli nuggets
description: These delicious cheesy broccoli nuggets are a fun way to get veggies into your little ones. They're easy to hold for little bubs, packed with nutrients, and have a nice cheesy flavour. Great for freezing and you can eat them hot or cold, making them a great lunchbox addition.
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
steps: Preheat your oven to 180C/350F
Steam your broccoli until tender, about 10 minutes.
Mash your broccoli, and add all other ingredients (egg, breadcrumbs and cheese)
Shape your nuggets - you should have between 18 and 20, depending on the size of your head of broccoli. If your mix is too wet, try adding more breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup at a time.
Place on a lined baking tray (or two) and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Cheesy broccoli rice balls
description: These cheesy broccoli balls are absolutely delicious, with an incredible arancini like texture and cheesy, garlic aftertaste (yum!). I know you’ll likely make these for your little one, but I think you’ll find you’ll eat at least half of them yourself. These are perfect for baby led weaning - you can even shape them into fingers for babies just starting out.
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
steps: Preheat your oven to 200C/390F.
Cut your broccoli into florrets and steam, then mash in a large bowl.
Add all remaining ingredients to your bowl and mix with hands.
Once combined, roll into golf sized balls. You should get about 20.
Add to a lined baking tray and pop in an oven for 18 minutes or until they start going golden brown.
Allow to cool slightly before enjoying. Store in the fridge for up to 3 days and freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Cheesy Veggie Risoni (Orzo) – A Creamy, Kid-Friendly Comfort Meal
description: If you’re looking for a quick, easy, and veggie-packed meal that both kids and adults will love, this Cheesy Veggie Risoni is it! Also known as orzo, risoni is a small, rice-shaped pasta that cooks up creamy and comforting—perfect for little eaters and a great way to sneak in extra vegetables without a fuss. This recipe comes together in 20 minutes, and is loaded with veggies, including broccoli,
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely choped or grated cauliflower
steps: Prep the Veggies: Chop the broccoli into small pieces, finely shred the carrot, and grate or finely chop the cauliflower. These small sizes help them cook quickly and blend seamlessly into the dish.
Sauté the Vegetables: In a medium pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the broccoli, carrot, cauliflower, and crushed garlic. Sauté for 5-6 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Add risoni and chicken stock: Stir in ½ cup risoni (orzo) and 1 ½ cups chicken broth.
Cook the Risoni: Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to medium-high. Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the risoni has absorbed most of the broth and is tender.
Make It Creamy & Cheesy: Once the risoni is fully cooked and the broth has mostly absorbed, stir in sour cream and cheddar cheese. Mix until everything is smooth, creamy, and melted.
Serve & Enjoy! Allow the dish to cool slightly before serving. Enjoy it on its own, or pair it with grilled chicken or fish for an extra boost of protein.

title: Creamy Cajun Chicken & Corn Orzo
description: Creamy Cajun Chicken & Corn Orzo Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces * 2 tbsp Britscookin Cajun seasoning, divided (plus more to taste, if needed) * 1 tsp smoked paprika * Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp olive oil * 2 tbs
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 tbsp Britscookin Cajun seasoning, divided (plus more to taste, if needed)
Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste
4 cups unsalted chicken broth (so you can control the sodium)
1½ cups whole kernel corn (fresh, frozen, or canned and drained)
¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
steps: Garnish
Crispy bacon, crumbled
Sliced green onions
Light sprinkle of smoked paprika (optional) ⸻ Directions

Season the chicken thighs (or chicken breasts) with 1 tablespoon of the Cajun seasoning, the smoked paprika, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for 5–7 minutes, until nicely browned. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the butter, then the diced onion. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the dry orzo and stir constantly for 1–2 minutes to lightly toast it.
Pour in the unsalted chicken broth, then stir in the cream-style corn and whole kernel corn. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan—they add tons of flavor.

Return the browned chicken and any juices to the pan. Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of Cajun seasoning, then bring everything to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the heavy cream and freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Taste and adjust with additional Cajun seasoning, salt, and black pepper, if needed.
Spoon into bowls and top with crispy bacon, sliced green onions, and a light sprinkle of smoked paprika. Notes
Chicken thighs stay extra juicy, but chicken breasts work great too.
Using unsalted chicken broth gives you more control over the final seasoning.
Let the orzo rest for about 5 minutes before serving. It will thicken slightly and become even creamier.

title: Creamy Italian Sausage Pasta
description: A weekly staple in our house!
ingredients: 1 cup Sauvignon Blanc (a little less than half a standard bottle)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Freshly grated Parmesan cheese, for serving
Cooked pasta of your choice (fettuccine, penne, or rigatoni work great)… I cook regular and GF pasta for this per my husbands request 🤣
steps: 1 Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the mild Italian sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
2 Stir in the diced onion with the browned sausage. Cook until the onion is soft and translucent, about 5-7 minutes.
3 Add the dried parsley. Pour in a little less than half a bottle of Sauvignon Blanc (around 1 cup). Stir, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Let the wine bubble and reduce for 3-4 minutes.
4 Lower the heat to medium-low and stir in 2 cups of heavy cream. Simmer gently for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
5 Toss the sauce with your cooked pasta of choice. Taste and season with salt and black pepper as needed.
Serve immediately with freshly grated Parmesan cheese on top.

A pinch of crushed red pepper flakes for heat
Fresh spinach or peas for color
A squeeze of lemon juice for brightness

title: Creamy Lemon Parmesan Chicken Orzo
description: Creamy Lemon Parmesan Chicken Orzo!
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken (I used thighs, but breasts work too)
Fresh parsley, for topping How I Make It: 1️⃣
steps: Season the chicken liberally with Britscookin Garlic & Herb, smoked paprika, and lemon pepper. 2️⃣ In a large skillet, heat a little olive oil and brown the chicken on both sides. title: Creamy Salmon Orzo Recipe (Boursin + Tomatoes)
description: A creamy, flavorful salmon orzo recipe made entirely in one pan for an easy weeknight dinner. Tender, seared and then oven-baked salmon is paired with perfectly cooked orzo, fresh spinach, and tomatoes, then tossed in a rich and herby Boursin cheese sauce for a comforting meal that’s ready in about 30 minutes.
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (4-6oz each, approx. 1 inch thick)
kosher salt and ground black pepper
2 ¾ cups chicken broth (more as needed to thin sauce)
5.3 ounces Boursin Garlic and Fine Herbs Spreadable Cheese
steps: Prep Oven: Preheat to 415℉.
Prep Salmon: Pat 4 salmon fillets dry with paper towel and season with kosher salt and ground black pepper.

Sear Salmon: Bring a large skillet or braiser to a medium-high heat (something oven safe with high sides). Drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil on the bottom. Once hot (flick water in the pan and it should sizzle), add the salmon fillets with the skin-side up. Sear for about 3-4 minutes.

Bake: Flip salmon over and move the whole skillet to the oven to bake for 8-10 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 140-145℉. Remove the salmon from the pan (the skin may come off - that's okay) and set aside on a plate (discard skin).
Sauté: Bring the skillet back to a medium heat and add 1 pint cherry tomatoes. Move around the pan for 1 minute. Add the diced onion and 1 teaspoon garlic. Sauté for 1-2 minutes or until softened.

Cook Pasta: Add 2 ¾ cups chicken broth, 1 ½ cups orzo, and 1 ½ teaspoons kosher salt to the pan; mix to combine. Cover and cook for 8-10 minutes or until the orzo is almost fully cooked (be sure to scrape the bottom and stir frequently to prevent sticking while it cooks - add splashes of broth, if needed).

Cheese + Spinach: Turn down the heat slightly, smash the tomatoes with the back of a fork, add 5.3 ounces Boursin Garlic and Fine Herbs Spreadable Cheese and chopped spinach to the pan. Mix to combine and let the cheese melt. Place the salmon back on top and let cook on a medium-low heat until the orzo is fully cooked.
Serve: Enjoy immediately with some parmesan cheese on top!

title: Creamy Shrimp Skillet
description: creamy street corn shrimp skillet 👩🏼‍🍳🤤🌽 What you’ll need: for the shrimp: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled & deveined 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp each of salt & pepper for the creamy street corn sauce:
ingredients: for the shrimp: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled & deveined
1/2 tsp each of salt & pepper for the creamy street corn sauce:
1/2 tsp onion powder Juice of 1 lime
1/3 cup milk (+ more if you want it creamier)
2 tbsp chopped cilantro To Serve: Extra cotija cheese Cilantro, freshly chopped Hot sauce Sliced avocado, optional
steps: Toss shrimp with olive oil, chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Cook shrimp for 1-2 minutes per side, until they are just pink and opaque. Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add butter. Sauté the corn, garlic, and jalapeño for 3-5 minutes, until the corn is slightly charred and fragrant.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Stir in the cream cheese until it is melted and smooth. Add cotija, lime juice, and milk. Stir until sauce is creamy. Add more milk if you’d like it a bit more saucy!

Let it simmer on low for a few minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Top with some extra cojita and a sprinkle of cilantro. Serve immediately. You can serve it as is, over rice, or cauliflower rice. Enjoy!

title: Creamy Street Corn Shrimp Skillet
description: This Creamy Street Corn Shrimp Skillet is an easy one-pan dinner made with juicy seasoned shrimp, charred corn, jalapeños, cotija cheese, and a rich, creamy street corn sauce. Packed with smoky, tangy flavors, it's a quick weeknight meal that's perfect served over rice or with warm tortillas.
steps: Toss shrimp with olive oil, chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Cook shrimp for 1-2 minutes per side, until they are just pink and opaque. Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add butter. Sauté the corn, garlic, and jalapeño for 3-5 minutes, until the corn is slightly charred and fragrant.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Stir in the cream cheese until it is melted and smooth. Add cotija, lime juice, and milk. Stir until sauce is creamy. Add more milk if you'd like it a bit more saucy!

Let it simmer on low for a few minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Top with some extra cotija and a sprinkle of cilantro. Serve immediately. You can serve it as is, over rice, or cauliflower rice. Enjoy!

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Wings
description: Crispy, golden, and packed with flavor, these baked chicken wings are surprisingly easy to make. You only need a few pantry spices and a hot oven for perfect results.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line two rimmed baking sheets with foil and fit them with oven-safe wire racks. You can also use parchment-lined baking sheets and skip the rack, but the racks do promote crispiness.

Blot the wings completely dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, toss them with melted butter (you can also skip the butter and just sprinkle the blotted skin with the spices; this helps with crispiness). Arrange the wings in a single layer on the baking sheets, making sure they don't touch. Sprinkle them with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.

Bake the wings until they are cooked through and the skin is browned and crispy. Depending on your oven and the wings used, this should take about 30-40 minutes. See the notes section below for more tips.
For extra-crispy skin, lower the oven temperature to 170°F and keep the wings in the cooling oven for 30-60 more minutes.
Serve immediately. They pair well with blue cheese or ranch dressing.

title: Crispy Baked Honey Sesame Chicken
description: crispy baked honey sesame chicken 🔥🍯🤤
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water, optional for thickening
steps: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees. Add a baking rack to a large baking sheet and lightly spray with oil to keep the chicken from sticking.
Add the cubed chicken, cornstarch, flour, seasoning, and the beaten egg in a large ziplock bag or Tupperware. Seal it tight with a lid and shake really well until the chicken is well coated.
Place the chicken in an even layer on the baking rack and spray lightly with more oil. Bake for 15 minutes, flip, and cook another 10 minutes until fully cooked and crispy.

Meanwhile, make the honey sesame sauce. Add all the sauce ingredients except the sesame seeds and cornstarch to a small pot. Turn the heat to medium low and whisk well. Let it come to a gentle simmer for a few minutes.

If you’d like to make it thicker, add the cornstarch and water mixture and whisk constantly for 2-3 minutes until the sauce turns glossy. Once it’s glossy, remove it from the heat and mix in the sesame seeds.

Place the cooked chicken in a large bowl and pour the honey sesame sauce over it. Mix gently. Serve immediately with rice and your choice of veggie. Top with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onion. Enjoy!

title: crispy coconut chicken bowls 🥥⭐️🍋‍🟩 recipe below!
description: crispy coconut chicken bowls 🥥⭐️🍋‍🟩 recipe below!
ingredients: power slaw (I mixed mine with juice from half a lime, 1 tbsp mayo and s&p to taste)
you could also do coconut rice!! whatever your heart desires truly 🫶🏼
steps: start by adding your chicken breasts to a bag, using something heavy, beat with something heavy(ish) until they’re nice and flat.
In a small bowl, beat your egg until smooth, set aside for now. On a plate, add your panko, coconut flakes, garlic powder, smoked paprika onion powder, salt & pepper. Mix until combined.
Dip each chicken breast into the egg, then in the coconut breading mixture. Using your fingers, press the breading into the chicken so it adheres better. Coat each side of the chicken.
Then heat your skillet over medium heat, add a generous drizzle of oil, then add your chicken in an even layer. Cook about 4-5 minutes per side.
I like to cover the pan so the chicken cooks faster. Once the chicken reaches 165, remove from heat and allow it to rest 3-4 minutes before slicing
Then it’s time to serve! I served ours with some power slaw, cubed pineapple and lime wedges! So so yummy & truly the perfect summer dinner

title: crispy fish taco bowls 🍋‍🟩🥑🌮✨
description: crispy fish taco bowls 🍋‍🟩🥑🌮✨ What you’ll need: For the fish: 1 lb cod, cut into chunks or strips 1/2 cup flour 1 cup panko breadcrumbs 1 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp cumin 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp Pepper 1 egg Oil spray For the mago salsa: 1 ripe mango, diced
ingredients: For the fish: 1 lb cod, cut into chunks or strips
1 egg Oil spray For the mago salsa: 1 ripe mango, diced
1/2 jalapeño, minced (optional) Juice of 1/2 lime Handful chopped cilantro
1 avocado, diced Salt For the sauce: 1/2 cup Greek yogurt
1/2 tsp garlic powder Salt For the bowl: Shredded red cabbage Choice of rice
steps: Start by prepping your cod by patting it very dry with paper towels, which is key for getting a crispy texture.

Set up a breading station with three bowls. In the first bowl, combine the flour with half of the chili powder, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. In the second bowl, beat the egg. In the third bowl, mix the panko breadcrumbs with the remaining spices.
Dredge each piece of cod in the flour, then dip it into the egg, and finally press it into the seasoned panko until fully coated.
Cook the cod using your preferred method. You can pan fry it in a thin layer of oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

You can also air fry it at 400 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes, spraying with oil and flipping halfway through, or bake it at 425 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes on a rack, making sure to spray well with oil. Once cooked, let the cod rest for a couple of minutes and finish with a light sprinkle of salt.

While the fish cooks, make the mango salsa by combining diced mango, finely diced red onion, minced jalapeño if using, lime juice, chopped cilantro, diced avocado, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together and let it sit so the flavors can meld.
For the sauce, whisk together Greek yogurt, mayo, lime juice, honey, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt until smooth. Taste and adjust the lime juice and salt as needed.

To build your bowls, start with a base of cooked rice such as white, brown, or cilantro lime rice, and add shredded red cabbage. Top with the crispy cod, a generous scoop of mango salsa, and a drizzle of the creamy sauce.

title: Crispy Mongolian Beef
description: Takeout is good… but takeout made at home is better!
ingredients: 3 lbs shaved sirloin, thinly sliced (or flank steak, sliced thin against the grain)
1 heaping tsp Better Than Bouillon Roasted Beef Base
1 bunch green onions, chopped For Serving
steps: Add the sliced steak to a bowl. Season with black pepper and cornstarch and toss until evenly coated.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Shallow fry the beef in batches until crispy on the outside. Remove and let drain.
In a bowl, whisk together water, Better Than Bouillon Roasted Beef Base, soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, sesame oil, red chili flakes, and ginger paste. Set aside.
In the same pan, add the chopped onion and optional red chili peppers. Cook until onions start to soften.
Add the garlic and cook just until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce and let it simmer and reduce slightly.
Add the beef back into the pan and toss to coat evenly.
Once the sauce thickens, turn off the heat and stir in the green onions.
Serve over rice and enjoy — so good, y’all.

1 can (10.5 oz) golden mushroom soup (or cream of mushroom)

12 oz angel hair pasta Optional garnish: grated Parmesan cheese, chopped parsley Steps
steps: Place chicken breasts in the bottom of the crockpot.
In a bowl, whisk together mushroom soup, chicken broth, Italian seasoning mix, black pepper, and garlic if using.
Pour sauce over chicken and top with butter slices.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4½–5½ hours, until chicken is tender and cooked through.
About 20–30 minutes before serving, add cream cheese cubes.
Cover and let soften, then stir until smooth and creamy.
Shred or slice chicken and stir back into the sauce.

Drain.

Garnish if desired.

title: Crockpot Cheesy Taco Potatoes
description: Crockpot Cheesy Taco Potatoes This is truly the easiest dump-and-go dinner.
steps: In a skillet, cook the ground beef with diced onion until fully cooked. Drain excess grease. Add minced garlic and 1 packet of taco seasoning. Stir and set aside.
Add frozen potatoes to the crockpot. Sprinkle in the second packet of taco seasoning. Add salsa, cheddar cheese soup, and the cooked taco meat.
Add 2 cups of shredded cheese and mix everything until well combined. Spread evenly, then top with the remaining 5 cups of cheese.
Cover and cook on low for 3.5–4 hours or high for 2 hours or until hot, bubbly, and potatoes are tender.
Scoop and top with your favorites! We always serve with corn chips & extra jalapeños!

title: Crockpot Chicken
description: Every week, I purchase a rotisserie chicken and shred the meat to have easy protein to grab.
ingredients: 2 cups of chicken broth with no added water!
So dust off that crockpot! Or if you have an insta pot use that, I’m scared of those lol! Who’s trying this one?🙋🏻‍♀️
steps: Remove giblets from chicken, rinse and tap dry .

Place whole chicken in crockpot and rub with oil on both sides. In a separate bowl, mix all seasonings together and rub evenly over chicken and inside skin as well. Place lid on slow cooker and set on low for 6 hours. Make sure temperature reads 165 F.

title: Crockpot Chicken Enchiladas
description: Skip the rolling and still get all the flavors you love. This Crockpot Chicken Enchiladas recipe is packed with tender shredded chicken, enchilada sauce, black beans, green chiles, and melty cheese for an easy slow cooker dinner that's perfect for busy weeknights and delicious as leftovers.
steps: Place the enchilada sauce, green chilis, chopped onion, black beans, and seasoning in the crockpot. Mix well.
Add the chicken to the crockpot making sure to cover it with the sauce.
Cook on high for about 2 1/2 hours or until the chicken is fully cooked.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the crockpot and shred it. Place the chicken back in the crockpot and give it a good stir.
To the top of the enchilada mixture add the sliced tortilla strips and shredded cheese.
Cook for another 30 minutes on high until the cheese is melted.
Serve with your choice of toppings. Enjoy!

title: Crockpot Chipotle Honey Pot Roast Tacos
description: Made in the crockpot or the oven, these tacos are simple to make, saucy, spicy, cheesy, and so yummy!

cilantro, green onion, avocado, and crumbled cotija cheese, for serving

Pour over the orange juice, 3/4 cup water, and the honey. Cover and roast for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until very tender.4. Crank the heat on the oven up to 425° F. Uncover and cook for 10 minutes, until deeply caramelized on top. Remove the meat from the pot and shred it using two forks. 5. title: Crockpot Cowboy Casserole 🤠🤌🏼
description: crockpot cowboy casserole 🤠🤌🏼
ingredients: 8oz bag of mini red potatoes, cubed
1 cup corn, canned & drained or frozen
1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 can Rotel (diced tomatoes with green chiles)
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, stirring in the diced onion
steps: Cook until the beef is fully cooked and the onion is soft. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds, just until fragrant.

Transfer the beef mixture to the crockpot. Add the diced potatoes, corn, black beans, Rotel, cream of mushroom, cream of chicken, beef broth, tomato paste, and all seasonings. Stir well until everything is evenly combined.
Cover and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours, stirring once halfway through, until the potatoes are fork tender. Start checking around the 3 hour mark since crockpots can vary.
Stir in the sour cream and cheese. Cover again and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes, until everything is creamy and heated through.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings. I usually add extra shredded cheddar, more sour cream, and sliced green onions. Enjoy!

title: Crockpot Creamy Boursin Pesto Pasta
description: Crockpot Creamy Boursin Pesto Pasta If you love creamy pesto pasta but want the easy crockpot version, this one is packed with flavor.
ingredients: 1 block Garlic & Herb Boursin (or 1 block cream cheese)
steps: Add the chicken breasts to the crockpot. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning.
Pour in the pesto and chicken broth. Cover and cook on Low for 4–5 hours or High for 2.5–3 hours, until the chicken is tender.
Cook the rotini pasta according to package directions and drain.
Shred the chicken in the crockpot, then stir in the Boursin cheese (or cream cheese) until creamy and combined. Add more salt and pepper as needed.
Add the cooked pasta and sliced cherry tomatoes and mix well.
Top with Italian blend cheese, cover for a few minutes until melted, then serve warm.

title: Crockpot Creamy Chicken Tortellini
description: What easy dinner recipe keeps you out of the drive thru?
ingredients: 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper
1 tsp onion powder and Italian seasoning
steps: Spray a crockpot with cooking spray. Add one pound of chicken breasts. Season with salt, pepper, onion powder, and Italian seasoning. Add 1 tbsp of minced garlic, marinara sauce, and Alfredo sauce.

Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Shred or cube up the chicken and add it back to the crockpot. Stir in the frozen tortellini. Add about one cup of Colby Jack cheese and cook on high for about 20 minutes or until the cheese tortellini is tender.
Stir everything together well and top with shredded Parmesan cheese and dried parsley.

title: Crockpot French Onion Dip Sandwiches
description: Crockpot French Onion Dip Sandwiches Tender, fall-apart chuck roast slow cooked with buttery onions and savory au jus, then piled onto toasted buns with melty provolone.
ingredients: 2 lb chuck roast Garlic powder, to taste Onion powder, to taste Black pepper, to taste Buttery garlic & herb seasoning, to taste @Kinder's Flavors
1 packet au jus gravy mix @Fire & Smoke Society
2 cups chicken broth For the Onions
2 tbsp butter For Serving Hoagie or sub rolls Provolone cheese
Evenly season the chuck roast on all sides with garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and buttery garlic & herb seasoning.
steps: Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chuck roast and sear for 2–3 minutes per side, or until nicely browned. Transfer the roast to your slow cooker.
Sprinkle the au jus gravy mix and beefy onion soup mix over the roast. Add the Worcestershire sauce and chicken broth.
In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add the sliced onion and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized.
Spoon the onions directly over the roast. Cover and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours, or until the beef is fall-apart tender.
Remove the roast from the slow cooker and shred it with two forks. Return the beef to the slow cooker and toss it with some of the onions and juices.
Pile the shredded beef and onions onto your buns and top with provolone cheese. For extra melty cheese, pop the assembled sandwiches under the broiler for a minute or two.
Ladle some of the cooking liquid from the slow cooker into small bowls and serve alongside the sandwiches for dipping.

title: Crockpot Honey Garlic Chicken and Noodles
description: Crockpot Honey Garlic Chicken and Noodles
ingredients: 1/3 cup each honey and soy sauce
2 tbsp each sriracha, hoisin sauce, and minced garlic
steps: In the crockpot, whisk together honey, soy sauce, sriracha, hoisin sauce, garlic, cornstarch, and chicken stock until fully combined.
Add chicken thighs and toss to coat in the sauce.
Cook on LOW for 5 hours or HIGH for 3 hours, until chicken is tender and cooked through.
Shred the chicken and stir into the sauce.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions, drain, and add them to the crockpot.
Stir everything together until the noodles are coated in the sauce.
Top with sesame seeds and green onions and serve!

title: CROCKPOT SALSA CHICKEN & RICE ✨

steps: Trim any visible fat from the chicken breasts.
Add all of the ingredients to a crockpot, and stir together.
Cover and cook on high 3 hours.
Shred the chicken using two forks, then gently stir everything together to combine.
Add toppings and enjoy!

title: Crockpot White Chicken Enchiladas 🤩

Gradually whisk in the chicken broth and milk until smooth and thickened, adjusting the heat to maintain a gentle simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the sour cream, salsa verde, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.

Top with the cheddar Jack and cheddar cheeses, cover, and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted.

Turn off the crockpot and let it sit for about 10 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken slightly. Top with your favorite toppings, such as hot sauce, sour cream, freshly sliced jalapeños, or cilantro. Enjoy!

title: Crunchwrap Casserole
description: Meals that helped me lose 45 pounds 🤍 Let’s make one of my favorites- Crunchwrap Casserole!

Bake for about 25 minutes, then slice and top with shredded lettuce and that taco sauce

title: Curry Meatballs
description: This recipe is truly one of our family’s favorites, AND it’s actually good for your PCOS 💅🏼✨ literally packed with 30G of protein 🤩 keep reading below to see how to make this bomb meal!
ingredients: 1 cup crushed whole grain crackers (I used Simple Mills almond flour)
Spice blend: 1 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp pepper, 1/4 tsp salt
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Mix all meatball ingredients together in a bowl and chill in the fridge for 20 mins. Roll mixture into balls and place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake 18 mins, or until meatballs reach an internal temp of 165 degrees F.

In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add red bell pepper and onion and saute 5-7 mins, until onions are translucent. Add red curry paste, coconut milk, and soy sauce and let simmer a few mins.
Add cooked meatballs to curry sauce and let simmer another 30-60 mins so flavors really come together. Garnish with fresh cilantro. I served mine with brown rice and sauteed mushrooms!

title: Dairy Free Pumpkin Muffins
description: These pumpkin muffins are not only easy to make at home, but taste even better than store bought!
ingredients: 15 ounce canned pumpkin puree or butternut squash puree (425 grams)
1/2 cup cup brown sugar, packed (100 grams)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F or 175°C and set an oven rack in the middle position.
Whisk together flour, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, baking powder, cloves, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add pumpkin pie filling, eggs, oil, and water. Make sure not to leave any of the dry mixture at the bottom. Smooth out any lumps you may find.
Use a ladle to pour batter into paper-lined muffin pan cups until about ⅔ full.
In a separate medium sized mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Add oil and use a fork to mix until combined into a streusel. If it's too dry, add the water.
Sprinkle the streusel on top of each cup of batter.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centers comes out clean.
Remove muffins and let cool for 10 minutes before moving to cooling rack.
In a small mixing bowl, combine powdered sugar, water, and vanilla until smooth.
Drizzle icing over each muffin.

title: Date Cake
description: Refined sugar free date cake🥮🍁 * 2 cups (9-ounces) medjool pitted dates * 1 ¼ cup hot milk of choice
ingredients: 1 ¼ cup hot milk of choice
steps: Place the pitted dates in a bowl and cover with hot milk. Soak until soft (about one hour)
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch cake pan
After the dates have softened, transfer them with the milk to a blender and blend for 15 seconds. Add the eggs, oil and vanilla extract and blend again until combined.
In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Pour the date and egg mixture into the dry ingredients and fold together.
Transfer the batter to the cake pan. Bake for 30-35 minutes.
Let cool completely and top with coconut manna (optional)!

title: Dijon Lemon Chicken
description: How to make the best meal prep Dijon lemon chicken!
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and add to an instant pot.
Cover with Italian seasoning and coat in dijon mustard.
Stir in the lemon juice and chicken stock. Season slightly more with a small amount of salt and pepper.
Add the lid and cook on high pressure for 30 minutes. Let the steam naturally release and then remove and enjoy the chicken! Would you try this?

title: Dole Whip (Ninja Creami)
description: Inspired by the classic Disney favorite, this Ninja Creami Dole Whip recipe is the BEST tropical treat! It's dairy-free, healthier, and only requires 4 simple ingredients. I love this refreshing dessert that combines the vibrant flavors of pineapple with the creamy texture of soft serve, all made effortlessly in the Ninja Creami machine!

Spin on the sorbet setting.

title: Dumb Dinners: Lazy Beef Udon
description: I already found cooking stressful, and then I had kids and it got a whole lot more stressful.
ingredients: ¾ cup beef broth, plus a splash more if needed
3 pouches udon noodles, about 7 oz each
green onions and sesame seeds to finish
chili crisp, optional for your own bowl
steps: Put the whole chuck roast in the crockpot. No cutting, no seasoning.
Pour the Korean BBQ sauce over it, then add the gochujang, garlic, and ¾ cup beef broth. Stir the liquid around the roast so the gochujang breaks up.

title: Easy pizza dough
description: Light and fluffy with the perfect crunchy bottom, this dough makes for the ultimate home made pizza. With a 60 minute rise, it's also quick to pull together, making it a great weeknight meal. I top mine with pizza sauce from Woolies, mozzarella, and whatever I have in the fridge. So easy!
sourceName: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.
ingredients: olive oil, to stick and grease
steps: Stir together warm water, yeast and honey. Once combined, sit for 5-10 minutes. It should be a little frothy.
Add your flour to a bowl. Make a well, then add your water/yeast mixture. Stir with a wooden spoon to combine.
Roll your dough out on a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Use your hands to lightly coat a bowl with olive oil, add your dough, then roll your dough around to coat it in oil. Rest for 60 minutes - it should double in size.
Preheat your oven to 200C fan-forced
Knead your dough again for 1-2 minutes. Do this on a clean surface (no flour). Your dough should have oil on it, so it shouldn't stick. If it is sticking, drizzle some olive oil on your bench.

Divide your dough into two sections - roll out each half into pizza sized shapes (around 30cm in diameter, and around 1/2 cm thick). Add to a pizza tray (I use a round baking tray with holes in it, from Kmart).
Cover your pizza with your base sauce (I use Leggo's Pizza Sauce Squeezy Tomato Paste), then top with mozzarella and your favourite toppings.
Bake at 200C fan-forced for 15 minutes or until cheese and edges are starting to brown.
Allow to cool slightly, then cut into triangles or strips for your little ones. Enjoy!

description: Garlic Soy Glazed Beef Bites 🥩🧄
ingredients: 2 lbs (900g) beef chuck or sirloin, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
Salt and black pepper, to taste
steps: Prep & Sear: Pat beef dry; season with salt/pepper and toss with cornstarch. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over high heat. Sear beef in batches until deeply browned (2-3 mins/side). Remove and set aside.

Build the Glaze: Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Sauté garlic and ginger 1 min until fragrant. Whisk in soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, broth, and honey. Simmer 3-5 mins until slightly thickened.

Combine & Bake: Return beef to pan, tossing to coat in glaze. Transfer to preheated 375°F (190°C) oven. Bake uncovered 25-30 mins, stirring halfway, until beef is fork-tender and glaze is sticky/caramelized.

Finish & Serve: Remove from oven. Let rest 5 mins. Garnish generously with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice, cauliflower rice, or lo mein noodles. Spoon extra glaze over top!
Pro Tips:
Dry beef = better sear. Moisture creates steam, preventing browning.
Don’t skip cornstarch. It creates a light crust and helps thicken the glaze.
Adjust sweetness: Use less brown sugar/honey for savory-leaning, more for sweet-sticky.
Make ahead: Tastes even better next day as flavors meld. Reheat gently with splash of broth.
Spice it up: Add ½ tsp red pepper flakes or 1 tbsp sriracha to glaze for heat.

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray an 8 ½ x 4 ½-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, salt, and ground nutmeg.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla until well combined.
Pour the milk mixture into the flour mixture and stir gently until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; the batter should be a bit runny.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan, spreading it evenly.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few crumbs and the top is golden brown.

Once baked, remove the bread from the oven and let it cool in the pan for about 10 minutes. Then, carefully remove the bread from the pan and place it on a wire rack set over parchment paper (to catch drips).

In a medium bowl, whisk together confectioners' sugar, 4 tablespoons milk, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until smooth. If too thick, add milk ½ tablespoon at a time until pourable. (It should be thick but drizzle easily.)

While the bread is still slightly warm, pour or spoon the glaze generously over the top, letting it drip down the sides. For full donut-style coverage, you can dip the top directly into the glaze or brush on extra layers.
Let the glaze set for 20 to 30 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Gluten free pot pie
description: Entering my cozy food season aka where i thrive 🥧🥕👩🏻‍🍳 Gluten free biscuit-topped pot pie: For the biscuit topping: ½ cup unsalted butter, melted 2 eggs 2 tbsp milk
ingredients: ¼ tsp garlic powder More melted butter, for brushing the biscuits For the filling:
½ of a medium yellow onion, finely diced
1 cup Yukon gold potatoes, diced into small cubed
¼ cup gluten free all-purpose flour (OR sub
3 sprigs of fresh thyme, stems removed About 4 cups shredded (cooked) chicken
steps: Start by making the biscuit dough. In a large bowl, whisk together the butter, eggs, and milk. Stir in the almond flour, baking powder, salt, and garlic powder. Set dough in the refrigerator to chill.
Preheat oven to 400°F
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat with the butter. Stir in onion, potatoes, and garlic. Allow to cook for 8 minutes.
if you don’t have an oven-safe skillet, you can transfer everything later to an oven-safe baking dish.

Next, whisk in the flour, italian seasoning, and salt and pepper then slowly pour in your broth while continuing to whisk. Add your milk of choice and the fresh thyme leaves. Give everything a good stir, then allow to thicken for 5 or so minutes.
Stir in your frozen mixed vegetables and chicken and allow to cook for another 5 minutes.
Using a cookie scoop out 8 biscuits on top of the filling. Brush each biscuit with melted butter.
Bake for 17-20 minutes, until filling is bubbly and biscuits are slightly browned and cooked through. Serve and enjoy!

title: Grain Free Chocolate Chip Cassava Cookie Bars
description: These cookie bars have a rich, buttery flavor, and they come together in one bowl and one pan. AND they’re naturally gluten-free and grain-free. Yesssssssssss (please)!! The bars are made with cassava flour, which lends the cookies a fluffy texture with a light but rich crumb. They’re irresistible when warm, and they freeze beautifully. The cookie bars are naturally sweetened with coconut sugar (a
sourceName: From Scratch Fast | Recipes from scratch for busy cooks!
ingredients: 3/4 cup (115 g) packed coconut sugar (sometimes labeled coconut palm sugar)
1 cup (130 g) cassava flour (I prefer Bob's Red Mill brand)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (175 degrees Celsius). Spray an 8x8-inch pan with cooking spray, then line it crosswise with parchment paper (this will make it easy to pull the cookie bars out later).

In the bowl of a stand mixer with the paddle attachment, combine the softened butter and coconut sugar. Mix on high until lightened in color and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add the eggs, honey and vanilla, and mix on high until incorporated, stopping and scraping the sides as needed, about 1 to 2 minutes. Add the cassava flour, baking powder and salt, and mix on low until incorporated (the batter will be thick). Scrape the sides, and add 1 cup of the chocolate chips and the pecans. Mix on low until just combined.

Spread the batter in an even layer in the prepared pan (it will be quite thick so will take a bit of work to get it into the corners—a small offset spatula works great). Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips. Bake until golden brown on top, about 24 to 26 minutes. Place the pan on a wire rack and let cool. Remove the cookie by pulling on the parchment handles. Cut it into bars using a sharp knife, cleaning the knife between slices (you can cut into 9 large bars or smaller bite-sized squares). If you’re anything like me, you’re going to want to serve these with cold milk or ice cream (yesssss)!!

title: GREATEST LASAGNA EVER
description: GREATEST LASAGNA EVER
ingredients: 32 oz mozzarella (16 oz shredded, 16 oz sliced)
2 quarts tomato basil sauce (jarred or homemade)
steps: 1️⃣ Sauté onions & garlic in oil, add beef + salt, brown well. Stir in tomato sauce, simmer, and salt to taste.
2️⃣ In a separate pan, sauté onions, garlic & spinach until wilted. Off heat, mix with ricotta, then eggs & parmesan. Season to taste.
3️⃣ Cook noodles until slightly al dente.
4️⃣ Butter a 9x13” dish. Line bottom with noodles, letting ends hang over edges.
5️⃣ Layer: thin meat sauce → noodles → 1/3 meat sauce + 1/4 mozzarella → noodles → 1/3 spinach mix. Repeat (3 full layers).
6️⃣ Fold over noodles, top with sauce, sliced mozzarella & remaining parmesan.
7️⃣ Cover with foil & bake at 350°F for 20 min. Uncover & bake 15 min more until browned. Let it rest, slice & serve!
Homemade Tomato Basil Sauce (Optional):
6 cans (28 oz) whole peeled tomatoes 20 garlic cloves, crushed l• 1 cup olive oil
Salt 4 oz fresh basil
Simmer all but basil for 25 min. Blend until smooth. Stir in basil, rest 10 min, salt to taste. Freeze the extra!

title: Greek Chicken Bowl
description: Recipe below👇🥗 Lemon Potatoes: 6-7 baby potatoes, quartered
steps: Add all ingredients to a roasting pan & bake at 400F for 35-45 minutes or until edges are starting to brown.
Chicken Souvlaki:

2 chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes 5 lemons, juiced 1/4 cup olive oil 4 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped 2 tbsp fresh oregano, chopped 1/2 tsp cumin powder 1/2 tsp chili flakes 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp pepper
In a large bowl, combine lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, chopped parsley, oregano, cumin powder, chili flakes, salt & pepper.
Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes and mix into bowl with other ingredients. Cover and place in the fridge to marinate for 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.

Preheat outdoor grill or grill pan and drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil. Thread chicken pieces onto skewers and place on grill, turning on all sides for about 8-10 minutes, until chicken is fully cooked through (165 F). Tzatziki:
5 cups plain Greek yogurt 1/2 english cucumber, grated 2-3 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp red wine vinegar 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper
Grate 1/2 an english cucumber using the large side of a box grater. Place grated cucumber in a fine mesh strainer to drain excess water.
Using your hands, squeeze all remaining water out of cucumber and transfer to bowl with Greek yogurt, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Mix together until combined.

title: Greek Turkey Meatballs
description: Replying to @Kahlua76 GREEK TURKEY MEATBALLS w/ ORZO SALAD ✨ Ingredients: GREEK TURKEY MEATBALLS - 1 lb lean ground turkey (see notes) 1 tbsp olive oil (15 g) 1 large egg 1/4 cup plain bread crumbs (28 g) 1/4 cup red onion (40 g) finely minced 3 cloves garlic minced 2 tbsp parsley, chopped 1 tbsp di
ingredients: 1/4 cup red onion (40 g) finely minced
1/4 cup red onion (40 g) finely diced
1/2 tsp garlic powder salt and pepper, to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 400 F and line a half baking sheet with parchment.

In a mixing bowl, mix together all turkey meatball ingredients and stir until just combined. Use a cookie scoop or spoon to form into 20 equal meatballs (~1.5 tbsp each). Bake 15 min, until golden brown and juices run clear (165F internal temp).
Meanwhile, cook the orzo according to box instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water.
For the lemon vinaigrette, whisk together lemon juice, dijon, honey, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while constantly whisking to emulsify.

Mix cooked orzo, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, feta and lemon vinaigrette. For meal prep, separate orzo salad equally into 4 containers with 5 meatballs each. Enjoy with fresh lemon and tzatziki! Notes:

I prefer 99/1 lean turkey for the most protein, but this can be too dry for some. I’d recommend using 93/7 if you like a juicier meatball. For the full printable recipe + tips & nutrition, search 🔍 “Greek turkey meatballs” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 💖 Enjoy!

title: Greek-Inspired Meatballs and Orzo
description: Greek-Inspired Meatballs and Orzo Lean Greek-Inspired Meatballs: -1 lb.
steps: Preheat the oven 350F
In a large bowl, mix all ingredients until combined
Scoop out even portions of the meat (I like to use a tablespoon scoop) and roll into balls, then place on a parchment-lined baking sheet
Bake for 10 minutes, turn over each meatball, then bake for another 7-10 minutes until the meatballs are cooked all the way through (reaching an internal temparature of ~160)
Remove from oven and let rest before adding into the orzo or packing up for the fridge Orzo:
1 tbsp butter 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 2 c orzo 3 c chicken bone broth salt (to taste)
pepper (to taste)
2 c spinach (chopped)
1/4 c sundried tomatoes (diced)
1/4 c crumbled feta cheese 1/4 c kalamata olives (diced) Instructions:
Heat butter and olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, pan then add in the orzo and stir occassionally until lightly toasted
Stir in the chicken bone broth and bring it to a light simmer for 5-8 minutes until the orzo has absorbed most of the broth
Add in salt and pepper, taste, and adjust
Once seasoned to your liking, stir in the spinach, sundried tomatoes, feta, and olives and cook for about a minute so the spinach cooks down
Add the meatballs into the orzo and cover to slightly reheat them (if needed), then cut the heat
Serve and enjoy!

title: Green Chicken Enchiladas
description: I promise you are going to want to make these.
steps: Mix green sauce with chilies and sour cream.
Smooth 1 spoonful of the sauce around the bottom of a pan.
Simmer the chicken broth in a skillet, and before placing each tortilla in the 9×13 pan, use tongs and pass the tortilla through the broth for just a few seconds.
Layer 6 tortillas over the first layer of sauce.
Layering order:
🌮 tortillas
🍗 1/2 chicken
🧀 1/3 of the cheese
🫕 1/3 of the sauce
Repeat.
Finish with final layer of tortillas, sauce and cheese.
Bake 350 for 30-35 mins uncovered until bubbly.

title: Ground Pork Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
description: who’s hungry?!!
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapple juice juice of 1/2 lime flour or corn small tortillas for the salsa: all finely chopped
½ lime juice Pinch salt for the Chili Lime Crema: ½ cup sour cream
1 tsp chili powder pinch of salt
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add the ground pork and break it apart with a spatula as it cooks. When it's about halfway cooked, stir in the minced garlic, chili powder, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until well incorporated.
Stir in the soy sauce, pineapple juice, and the juice of ½ lime. Let everything simmer for about 5 more minutes, until the liquid slightly reduces and the pork is fully cooked.

While the pork cooks, make the pineapple salsa by combining the finely chopped pineapple, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir well and set aside so the flavors can meld together.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the sour cream, mayo, lime juice, honey, chili powder, and a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame until soft and lightly charred.

Assemble the tacos by filling each tortilla with the pork, topping with the fresh pineapple salsa, and finishing with a generous drizzle of the chili lime crema. Serve immediately with extra lime wedges if desired

title: Hailey Bieber Meatballs with Tipsy Tomato Sauce
description: But of course with my tipsy tomato sauce 😉 Hailey Bieber meatballs but with my own little tweaks ⬇️ Meatballs 1 lb ground chicken 1/2 cup cottage cheese 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs 1/2 cup grated Parmesan 1 large egg 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper Olive
ingredients: 1/4 tsp black pepper Olive oil, for cooking Vodka Sauce
1/2 cup grated Parmesan Salt and black pepper, to taste For serving Grated Parmesan Red pepper flakes Fresh basil
steps: Add the ground chicken, cottage cheese, panko, Parmesan, egg, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper to a bowl. Mix gently until just combined.
Roll into meatballs

Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden on all sides and completely cooked through to 165°F, about 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer the meatballs to a serving plate.
In the same skillet, add the olive oil, butter and red pepper flakes. Cook for about 30 seconds.
Add the vodka and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Lower the heat and stir in the heavy cream and Parmesan until the sauce is creamy and smooth.
Spoon the warm vodka sauce generously over the cooked meatballs.
Finish with more grated Parmesan, red pepper flakes and fresh basil

title: Ham Cheddar + Chive Protein Biscuits
description: Ham Cheddar + Chive Protein Biscuits!
ingredients: 1/4 cup milk, plus more for brushing tops
7 oz deli ham, diced in to small pieces
1/3 cup diced green onion OR chives (or a mix)
steps: Preheat oven to 425 and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Blend cottage cheese and milk until creamy. In a large bowl, mix with honey and melted butter, then fold in ham, cheese, and green onion.
In a separate large bowl, mix together all of your dry ingredients. Add to your wet ingredients and mix until just combined- dough will be crumbly and looks slightly dry. That’s OK!
Turn your dough out onto a clean floured work surface. Use floured hands to combine the dough to make it less crumbly and into more of a smooth dough.

Roll dough out as much as you can into a rectangle (ish) about 3/4 inch thick. Don’t worry about it being too perfect! Fold one end of the rectangle into the center, and then the other end of the rectangle over it, like a letter.

Flatten dough again into a more narrow rectangle that is again about 3/4 inch thick. Repeat the process of folding one end into the center and then the other end over it. This is what creates the layers in the biscuits!
Roll a little once again just to pack layers together more tightly. Cut dough into 6-9 biscuits and place on baking sheet almost touching each other.

Brush the tops with milk and then bake for 20-30 minutes (depending on size of your biscuits- smaller ones will cook faster), until tops are slightly brown in centers are set. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before enjoying. Optional: brush tops w/ butter + honey!

title: hash brown egg nests
description: meal prep breakfast on repeat!!!
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh chives, finely chopped Hot sauce or ketchup, for serving
steps: Preheat your oven to 425°F & generously grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine the thawed hash browns, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and 1/2 cup of the shredded cheddar cheese. Mix until everything is evenly combined. Divide the hash brown mixture evenly between the muffin cups. Using your fingers, press the mixture firmly into each cup, making the sides slightly thicker and the bottom thinner. Use the bottom of a 1/4 or 1/3 cup measuring cup to gently press down and create a nest in the center of each. Lightly spray the tops of the hash browns with cooking spray to help them crisp. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and starting to crisp. Remove the pan from the oven. Carefully crack one egg into each hash brown nest, then sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese evenly over the tops. Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 10-12 minutes, depending on how you like your eggs. For a runnier yolk, check them around the 10-minute mark. For a firmer yolk, bake a little longer. Let the egg cups cool in the muffin pan for about 10 minutes before carefully loosening the edges with a small knife and removing them. Top with a sprinkle of salt, black pepper, and freshly chopped chives. Serve warm with your favorite hot sauce or ketchup.

title: Hawaiian Roll Recipe
description: Ditch the crap and enjoy fresh homemade Hawaiian Rolls with just 7 simple ingredients!
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons melted butter (for on top of rolls)
steps: In a small bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and 1 T honey. Stir lightly and let it sit for 5-10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour & salt. Warm oil plus remaining honey and add it to the flour mixture.
Add the frothy yeast mixture + the rest of the honey to the bowl and mix well.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 2-3 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Shape into 12 ball shapes and place them in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish or on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Cover the shaped rolls with a clean kitchen towel and let them rise for 30-45 minutes, or until puffy.
Gently brush the rolls with the melted butter before placing them in the oven Preheat your oven to 375°F Bake the rolls for 18-20 minutes, or until golden brown on top.
While the rolls are still warm, brush them with the remaining melted butter.
Once cooled slice through the entire section of 12 rolls and layer ham, mayo, and cheese.
Place the top half of the rolls back on top and put back in the oven for 8-10 minutes!
Pull apart and enjoy!

title: Hawaiian Teriyaki Bowls
description: hawaiian-inspired teriyaki bowls 🌴🌺🍯🍍🥒 recipe below!
ingredients: sriracha mayo (1 tsp @Yellowbird Foods sriracha & 2 tbsps mayo) add a splash of water & mix until smooth
steps: First we’ll start on the sauce. Add all of the ingredients into a medium sized bowl (listed above). Whisk together until smooth. Set aside for now.
Heat up your skillet over medium heat, add a splash of avocado oil and a pound of ground chicken. Break it up til it’s brown you know the drill.
While we wait for it to brown, I started prepping my toppings. Cubed pineapple, thinly sliced jalapeño, roughly chopped green onions, thinly sliced red onion and Persian cucumber.
watch your chicken and stir periodically
By then out chicken should be fully browned. Give your sauce a quick mix then pour into the pan with the chicken. Mix until well coated. Allow it to simmer 4-5 minutes.
While that’s simmering, I did a quick sriracha mayo (measurements listed above).
Stir in 1 tbsp arrowroot starch to thicken the sauce. Stir until thickened ~30 seconds (the best hack ever) then it’s time to serve!

title: Healthier General Tso's
description: Healthier General Tso's Chicken 🐓🔥
ingredients: Seasonings: Salt, pepper, garlic powder & onion powder
Jasmine rice cooked in chicken bone broth.
Salt, pepper & onion powder to taste
1/4 cup light brown sugar, tightly packed
Note(s): Some measurements are estimated, adjust ingredients to your liking. Could
also sub for chicken breasts if you prefer.
steps: Add all pf the general tso’s sauce ingredients to a small pot and mix. Bring it to a low boil and continue mixing until the sauce thickens. Should take 3-5 minutes. Once done, set aside.
Trim the chicken thighs to your liking then cut them into bite sized cubes.
Place the chicken into a large bowl. Drizzle in some avocado oil and season generously with salt, pepper, onion powder & garlic powder. Mix till well combined.

Get a large skillet going over medium-high heat and spray with cooking oil. Add in the chicken and let cook for 10-15 minutes mixing every few minutes until the chicken is crispy and cooked all the way through (largest piece should reach ~175 degrees internal)
Once the chicken is about done, lower the heat and add in the steamed broccoli along with ~3/4 of the general tso’s sauce. Let cook and continue mixing until the sauce thickens.
Plate it up & ENJOY! 🙌🏻

title: Healthy Baked Apple Fritters "Cookies" (gluten free + dairy free)
description: These Healthy Baked Apple Fritters are soft, cozy, and naturally sweetened with apples and applesauce. Made with oats, oat flour, and warm cinnamon, they’re a gluten-free and dairy-free snack or breakfast your toddler (and you!) will love. Easy to make in one bowl, freezer-friendly, and perfectly sweet without any added sugar.
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped (or shredded) apple (Honeycrisp, Fuji, or Gala are my faves)
½ tsp cinnamon (or measure with your heart!)
1 egg (or flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp warm water, let thicken))
1 tbsp oil (melted coconut or avocado oil or butter)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk together the egg (or flax egg), applesauce, vanilla, and oil until smooth.
Stir in oats, oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon until combined, then fold in the chopped apple.
Scoop 2-3 tablespoons of batter per fritter onto the baking sheet and flatten slightly.
Brush or spray the tops with a little oil and bake for 16-20 minutes, until golden and set.
Let cool slightly before serving. Drizzle with glaze drizzle if desired or pair with yogurt to dip!

title: HEALTHY FUDGY BROWNIES 🍫🍌
description: HEALTHY FUDGY BROWNIES 🍫🍌
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mash bananas until smooth.
Mix in yogurt, peanut butter, egg, maple syrup, and vanilla.
Stir in cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
TIP- adding espresso powder brings out the chocolate flavor
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into a lined or greased baking dish and top with extra chocolate chips.
Bake for about 25–30 minutes. Don’t overbake if you want them extra fudgy!
Let cool before slicing.

title: Healthy Gluten-Free Greek Yogurt Pancakes
description: if you're looking for thick, fluffy, and flavorful pancakes that are secretly packed with protein and naturally gluten-free, these healthy greek yogurt vanilla pancakes are your new breakfast best friend.
ingredients: 1 cup gluten-free 1:1 baking flour (make sure it includes xanthan gum or add 1/4 tsp if not)
1/4 tsp salt 2 large eggs 1 cup plain greek yogurt (dairy-free or regular)
2 tbsp melted butter or coconut oil (or neutral oil)
1 to 2 tbsp maple syrup (optional, for sweetness)
steps: in a medium bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
in another bowl, mix the greek yogurt, eggs, milk, melted butter, vanilla, and maple syrup until smooth.
pour the dry ingredients into the wet and gently stir until just combined. don't overmix—slightly lumpy batter is okay. let the batter rest for 5–10 minutes to thicken.
heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-low heat and grease lightly.

scoop the batter (about 1/4 cup per pancake) and spread gently if needed. sprinkle cinnamon sugar mixture if desired. cover the pan with a lid and cook for 2–3 max minutes per side, flipping once bubbles form and the edges look set. covering traps steam, which helps the pancakes rise higher and stay super moist and fluffy.
serve warm with fruit, yogurt, nut butter, or maple syrup.

title: Healthy Orange Chicken
description: ✨ 30 Minute Healthy Orange Chicken recipe without all the extra calories and high sodium levels.
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
1/2 tsp baking soda Salt to taste
2 tbsp fresh orange juice 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp ginger, minced To make Orange Sauce
1/4 cup rice vinegar 1 1/2 tbsp chili garlic sauce (optional)
3 tbsp brown sugar Salt to taste
steps: In a medium-size bowl combine all the ingredients under the “to marinate chicken” section and mix it thoroughly and marinate the chicken for at least 10 minutes. In a separate bowl combine orange juice, soy sauce, vinegar, chili garlic sauce, cornstarch, orange zest, garlic, ginger, red chili flakes, brown sugar, and salt. Whisk it until the sugar dissolves and keep the sauce mixture aside. Heat a wide skillet; add oil and once the oil is heated add the marinated chicken pieces to it. Cook on a medium flame for 4-5 minutes and flip the chicken pieces to the next side and cook for 5-6 more minutes until the chicken is cooked perfectly. Stir in the prepared sauce mixture to the skillet and cook the chicken along with the sauce uncovered for 5 minutes. The sauce will start to thicken and everything comes together. In this stage add the sesame seeds and green onions. Serve the orange chicken along with rice and veggies.

title: Healthy Pumpkin Bread
description: In the event that you’re almost ready too, I figured I’d drop my favorite pumpkin bread recipe.
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut oil, melted and cooled
5 cups flour or 1:1 gluten free flour blend
3/4 tsp baking soda Almond milk (I used about 3 tbsp) Chocolate chips (measure with your heart-l used about 1/3 cup but you can sub for nuts or just forego)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F. Grease and line a loaf pan with parchment paper. Set aside.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs until slightly fluffy (about 2 minutes). Add the remaining wet ingredients and mix until combined.

Stir in the flour, spices, baking powder and baking soda. Mix until combined. At this point, my batter was a little dry because I only had medium sized eggs. If you find it’s not a liquid-y batter (similar to brownie batter), add a few tbsp at a time of your favorite milk and whisk until you reach your desired consistency.
Finally, if using chocolate chips, stir them in. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and top with additional chocolate chips.
Bake in preheated oven for 40-50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out mostly clean. Remove from oven and let cool in the pan for a few minutes before removing and slicing.

title: HEALTHY PUMPKIN LOAF 🎃🍞
description: HEALTHY PUMPKIN LOAF 🎃🍞
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Whisk coconut oil, maple syrup, pumpkin purée and vanilla until smooth. Add the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Pour into a greased or parchment-lined 8 x 4 inch loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes. Let cool completely before glazing.
MAPLE GLAZE 🍁 1 cup powdered sugar (@lakanto)
1/4 cup maple syrup
Dash of vanilla extract
Whisk everything together until smooth, adding 1-2 tsp milk or water if needed. Drizzle over the cooled loaf, let set, slice & enjoy!

title: Herby Lemon Garlic Chicken & Rice (with feta & hummus)
description: Herby Lemon Garlic Chicken & Rice (with feta & hummus) 🍋🧄🌱
ingredients: (Serve with rice, extra lemon, feta, parsley & hummus or tzatziki)
steps: Whisk together all marinade ingredients then submerge chicken being sure to coat all sides. Allow to marinate at least an hour (the longer the better.)
Shake off excess marinade and pan fry over medium heat (~6-7 minutes on each side) until internal temp reaches 165°. Remove and allow to rest.

You can also GRILL your chicken but it was too cold for that today 🥶 OR BAKE: shake off excess marinade and place chicken in a baking dish. Bake uncovered at 400° for 20-25 minutes (internal temp 165°)
Prepare your bowl by adding rice and seasoning it with lemon juice, parsley and salt to taste.
Top with chicken and sprinkle with feta cheese and hummus/tzatziki.
Enjoy!

title: High Protein Biscuits
description: Don’t let homemade biscuits intimidate you - these easy high-protein biscuits are incredibly forgiving and perfect for beginners. The quick, no-knead dough bakes up soft and flaky every time, all thanks to the secret ingredient: cottage cheese.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Add the cottage cheese and maple syrup to a high-powered blender and blend until completely smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in the butter. Add the cold grated butter and use a fork to mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

Add the blended cottage cheese mixture and stir until a dough forms. At first, the dough may look a little rough and shaggy, but this is normal. As you gently fold and pat it, it will come together into a soft, workable dough.

Place the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat it down into a 1-inch thick round. Fold the dough over itself, then pat it back down into a 1-inch-thick round. Repeat this folding and patting process about 10 times. This helps create flaky, layered biscuits. (Note: It's important to gently pat and not knead or roll.) After the final fold, pat the dough into a 1-inch-thick round and cut out biscuits using either a biscuit cutter or a small circular cookie cutter.

After cutting out the biscuits, gently gather the dough scraps and press them together (do not knead). Pat the dough back into a 1-inch-thick round and cut out additional biscuits. I was able to get about 8 biscuits out of this dough.
Place biscuits on a baking sheet and bake 12–15 minutes, until golden. If desired, immediately brush with melted butter as soon as they come out of the oven.

title: High Protein Breakfast Bites
description: This is the breakfast meal prep we make on repeat.
steps: Cook the sausage, then remove from the pan.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan and season with salt.
Add the cooked sausage and scrambled eggs to a bowl along with the cottage cheese and shredded cheese.
Mix in the flour and the extra egg to bind everything together.
Bake at 375°F for about 18 minutes.

title: High Protein Breakfast Sandwiches
description: Sheet pan high protein breakfast sandwiches 🥯🍳 .
steps: Preheat oven to 350 F 2.Add eggs to bowl and whisk 3.Mix in cottage cheese, sliced pepper, chives and salt 4.Add egg mixture to a sheet pan and bake for 15 mins 5.Build your bagels, spray with olive oil or avocado oil and bake for another 5-8 mins until cheese is melted 6.Eat right away or wrap in aluminum or parchment and store in fridge or freezer.
Reheat when ready to eat! .
